17.s: atha dīkṣāvidhānaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśaḥ paṭalaḥ
17.d: अथ दीक्षाविधानं नाम षोडशः पटलः
17.m: Now begins the fifteenth chapter, named 'Rules for the Fire Ritual'.

17.s: nāradaḥ -
17.d: नारदः -

17.s:
śrotumicchāmi bhagavandīkṣālakṣaṇamuttamam |
samayinaḥ putrakasya sādhakācāryayostathā || 1 ||
17.d:
श्रोतुमिच्छामि भगवन्दीक्षालक्षणमुत्तमम् ।
समयिनः पुत्रकस्य साधकाचार्ययोस्तथा ॥ 1 ॥
17.m:
Having performed japa according to his capacity, at the conclusion of japa he should worship the Lord
with devotion, with arghya and flowers, and then with incenses and unguents. // 1

17.s:
naiṣṭhikānāṃ tathā strīṇāṃ śiśūnāṃ bhāvitātmanām |
vistareṇa samākhyāhi yadi sānugraho'si me || 2 ||
17.d:
नैष्ठिकानां तथा स्त्रीणां शिशूनां भावितात्मनाम् ।
विस्तरेण समाख्याहि यदि सानुग्रहोऽसि मे ॥ 2 ॥
17.m: Afterwards, O brahmin, he should gratify the Lord situated in the middle of the fire.

17.s: śrībhagavān -
17.d: श्रीभगवान् -

17.s:
śṛṇu dīkṣāṃ pravakṣyāmi śiṣyāṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām |
devāgnigurupūjāsu adhikāro yathā(yā ?)bhavet || 3 ||
17.d:
शृणु दीक्षां प्रवक्ष्यामि शिष्याणां भावितात्मनाम् ।
देवाग्निगुरुपूजासु अधिकारो यथा(या ?)भवेत् ॥ 3 ॥
17.m: To the north of the deity he should make a kuṇḍa possessing the proper characteristics, // 2

17.s: siddhaye muktaye caiva tāṃ vakṣyāmi tridhā yathā |
17.d: सिद्धये मुक्तये चैव तां वक्ष्यामि त्रिधा यथा ।
17.m:
or elsewhere from the deity's temple, on a piece of ground endowed with the proper characteristics,
in an auspicious, level pavilion provided with an exit for smoke. // 3

17.s: [āḍhyānāḍhyabhedena dīkṣāprakāre bhedaḥ]
17.d: [आढ्यानाढ्यभेदेन दीक्षाप्रकारे भेदः]
17.m:
There he should first make an altar, square on all sides,
endowed with all auspicious characteristics; above it he should make the kuṇḍa. // 4

17.s: mahāmaṇḍalayāgena vittāḍhyānāṃ tu kārayet || 4 ||
17.d: महामण्डलयागेन वित्ताढ्यानां तु कारयेत् ॥ 4 ॥
17.m: [It may be] square, regular, and superior, or pleasingly circular, / or situated in the cardinal and intermediate directions, suited for rites performed for specific desires. // 5

17.s:
p. 155) vittayogavimuktasya svalpavittasya dehinaḥ |
saṃsārabhayabhītasya viṣṇubhaktasya tattvataḥ || 5 ||
17.d:
प्। 155) वित्तयोगविमुक्तस्य स्वल्पवित्तस्य देहिनः ।
संसारभयभीतस्य विष्णुभक्तस्य तत्त्वतः ॥ 5 ॥
17.m: Whether free from desire or possessing desires, in the center and in all directions:

17.s:
agnau cājyānvitairbījaiḥ satilaiḥ kevalaistathā |
dravyahīnasya vai kuryādvācaivānugrahaṃ guruḥ || 6 ||
17.d:
अग्नौ चाज्यान्वितैर्बीजैः सतिलैः केवलैस्तथा ।
द्रव्यहीनस्य वै कुर्याद्वाचैवानुग्रहं गुरुः ॥ 6 ॥
17.m: [Different results according to the direction of the kuṇḍas]

17.s: [upasannasyāvaśyaṃ dīkṣayitavyatā]
17.d: [उपसन्नस्यावश्यं दीक्षयितव्यता]
17.m: When Hari, whose self is mantra, is gratified in a kuṇḍa situated in the northeast direction, // 6

17.s:
yaḥ samaḥ sarvabhūteṣu virāgī vītamatsaraḥ |
jitendriyaḥ śucirdakṣaḥ samagrāvayavānvitaḥ || 7 ||
17.d:
यः समः सर्वभूतेषु विरागी वीतमत्सरः ।
जितेन्द्रियः शुचिर्दक्षः समग्रावयवान्वितः ॥ 7 ॥
17.m: he grants earthly success to that great-souled man who desires such success. / One intent on aerial movement should offer oblations in a kuṇḍa situated in the eastern direction. // 7

17.s:
karmaṇā manasā vācā bhīteṣvabhayadaḥ sadā |
saṃbuddhipadasaṃprāptastatrāpi bhagavanmayaḥ || 8 ||
17.d:
कर्मणा मनसा वाचा भीतेष्वभयदः सदा ।
संबुद्धिपदसंप्राप्तस्तत्रापि भगवन्मयः ॥ 8 ॥
17.m: For the subjugation of enemies, [he should perform] the oblation in one situated in the southeast direction; / one desiring pacification should always perform the oblation in a southern-direction kuṇḍa. // 8

17.s:
pañcakālarataścaiva pañcarātrārthavittathā |
viṣṇutattvaṃ parijñāya ekaṃ cānekabhedagam || 9 ||
17.d:
पञ्चकालरतश्चैव पञ्चरात्रार्थवित्तथा ।
विष्णुतत्त्वं परिज्ञाय एकं चानेकभेदगम् ॥ 9 ॥
17.m: For the eradication of others, [the oblation is done] in a kuṇḍa situated in the southwest direction; / and one desiring the conquest of untimely death, for the pacification of all afflictions, // 9

17.s: dīkṣayenmedinīṃ sarvāṃ kiṃ punaścopasarpitān |
17.d: दीक्षयेन्मेदिनीं सर्वां किं पुनश्चोपसर्पितान् ।
17.m:
[performs] the oblation in a kuṇḍa of the western direction, when the mantra is gratified. / (Having offered in a western kuṇḍa, the wise man should gratify the mantra?)
When the mantra is gratified in a kuṇḍa of the northwest direction, then // 10

17.s: [ekasyaivācyutasyānekarūpeṇa sthitatvanirdeśaḥ]
17.d: [एकस्यैवाच्युतस्यानेकरूपेण स्थितत्वनिर्देशः]
17.m: the king of mantras quickly bestows various treasures; / and he grants health, prosperity, and nourishment, // 11

17.s: nirāśrayamasaṅkalpaṃ svarūpādacyutaṃ sthiram || 10 ||
17.d: निराश्रयमसङ्कल्पं स्वरूपादच्युतं स्थिरम् ॥ 10 ॥
17.m: when gratified in a kuṇḍa of the northern direction; there should be no doubt about this.

17.s:
grāhyagrāhakadharmaiśca nirmuktamacalaṃ dhruvam |
eva(ka ?)meva phale pañca(?)vakṣye te naikadhā sthitam || 11 ||
17.d:
ग्राह्यग्राहकधर्मैश्च निर्मुक्तमचलं ध्रुवम् ।
एव(क ?)मेव फले पञ्च(?)वक्ष्ये ते नैकधा स्थितम् ॥ 11 ॥
17.m: [Different measurements of kuṇḍas according to the number of oblations]

17.s: vyāptavyāpakabhedena yathāvanmunisattama |
17.d: व्याप्तव्यापकभेदेन यथावन्मुनिसत्तम ।
17.m: In an offering of fifty oblations, the kuṇḍa should be twelve digits [wide]. // 12

17.s:
[parasūkṣmasthūlātmanā tridhā sthiteṣu tattveṣu acyutasya tredhā vyāpya
sthitiḥ]
17.d:
[परसूक्ष्मस्थूलात्मना त्रिधा स्थितेषु तत्त्वेषु अच्युतस्य त्रेधा व्याप्य
स्थितिः]
17.m: In an offering of one hundred and eight, it should be equal to a fist-aratni; / and in an offering of one hundred and fifty, an aratni with the little finger. // 13

17.s: sthūlaṃ sūkṣmaṃ paraṃ cānyadvyāpya tattvatrayaṃ sthitam || 12 ||
17.d: स्थूलं सूक्ष्मं परं चान्यद्व्याप्य तत्त्वत्रयं स्थितम् ॥ 12 ॥
17.m: In an offering of a thousand, a cubit; in one termed ten thousand, two cubits; / in an offering of a hundred thousand, four cubits; and in an offering of ten million, eight cubits. // 14

17.s:
pradhānapuruṣeśākhyaṃ tathā'nyacchrotrapūrvakam |
vyāpyācyutaḥ sthitassākṣāt tridhā vai buddhipaścimam || 13 ||
17.d:
प्रधानपुरुषेशाख्यं तथाऽन्यच्छ्रोत्रपूर्वकम् ।
व्याप्याच्युतः स्थितस्साक्षात् त्रिधा वै बुद्धिपश्चिमम् ॥ 13 ॥
17.m: [Measurement of the excavation]

17.s:
trividhaṃ viṣṇutattvaṃ tu ekaṃ jñātvā'pyanekadhā |
ekaikena tu bhedena kuryātsarveṣvanugraham || 14 ||
17.d:
त्रिविधं विष्णुतत्त्वं तु एकं ज्ञात्वाऽप्यनेकधा ।
एकैकेन तु भेदेन कुर्यात्सर्वेष्वनुग्रहम् ॥ 14 ॥
17.m: The excavation is everywhere praised as half the width; / [extending] outward from the excavation in front by two [digits] from one's earlier measurement of the mekhala, // 15

17.s: yathānurūpaṃ kramaśaḥ samayajñādiṣu dvija |
17.d: यथानुरूपं क्रमशः समयज्ञादिषु द्विज ।
17.m: leaving [space for] the construction of the mekhala, he should then begin.

17.s: [mantramūrterbhagavatastredhā'vasthānam]
17.d: [मन्त्रमूर्तेर्भगवतस्त्रेधाऽवस्थानम्]
17.m: [Different measurements of the mekhalas according to the measurement of the kuṇḍa]

17.s: piṇḍātmā bhagavāneka upāṅgāḍhyaśca sa dvidhā || 15 ||
17.d: पिण्डात्मा भगवानेक उपाङ्गाढ्यश्च स द्विधा ॥ 15 ॥
17.m: The measurement of the mekhalas is stated to be twelve barley-corns // 16

17.s: trividhe mantrarāśau tu tridhā caiva vyavasthitaḥ |
17.d: त्रिविधे मन्त्रराशौ तु त्रिधा चैव व्यवस्थितः ।
17.m: for a kuṇḍa measuring twelve digits. / The height of the mekhalas is equal to their width, O wise one. // 17

17.s: [sthūlasūkṣmaparātmanā mantrarāśestraividhyam]
17.d: [स्थूलसूक्ष्मपरात्मना मन्त्रराशेस्त्रैविध्यम्]
17.m: And when the triad of mekhalas is combined together, / their width and then height become four and a half digits. // 18

17.s: maṇerākṛṣṭimantrānto māntraḥ prāgrāśirucyate || 16 ||
17.d: मणेराकृष्टिमन्त्रान्तो मान्त्रः प्राग्राशिरुच्यते ॥ 16 ॥
17.m: For a kuṇḍa of an aratni, the mekhalas are taught to be two digits; / for a kuṇḍa of [an aratni] with the little finger, two and a half digits. // 19

17.s:
p. 156) lakṣmyādyo bhūdharāntaśca dvitīyaḥ sūkṣmasaṃjñitaḥ |
saptāmūrmū(rṇānmū ?)rtimantrāntastṛtīyastu paraḥ smṛtaḥ || 17 ||
17.d:
प्। 156) लक्ष्म्याद्यो भूधरान्तश्च द्वितीयः सूक्ष्मसंज्ञितः ।
सप्तामूर्मू(र्णान्मू ?)र्तिमन्त्रान्तस्तृतीयस्तु परः स्मृतः ॥ 17 ॥
17.m: For a kuṇḍa measuring one cubit, the uniform [size] is taught to be three digits; / for one of two cubits, O best of the twice-born, the mekhalas are four digits. // 20

17.s: tattva (mantra ?) grāmaṃ samuccitya sthitaḥ saṃkṣepakarmaṇi |
17.d: तत्त्व (मन्त्र ?) ग्रामं समुच्चित्य स्थितः संक्षेपकर्मणि ।
17.m: For one of four cubits, all should be made six digits; / and for a kuṇḍa of eight cubits, they are taught to be eight digits. // 21

17.s:
[sthūlasūkṣmaparātmanā tredhā'vasthitasya mantrarāśeḥ
sthūlādyekaikarāśau pratyekaṃ sthūlāditrikarūpeṇāvasthitiḥ]
17.d:
[स्थूलसूक्ष्मपरात्मना त्रेधाऽवस्थितस्य मन्त्रराशेः
स्थूलाद्येकैकराशौ प्रत्येकं स्थूलादित्रिकरूपेणावस्थितिः]
17.m: [Characteristics of the navel]

17.s: tritrikāvastharūpeṇa trayaṃ kṛtvā tridhā svayam || 18 ||
17.d: त्रित्रिकावस्थरूपेण त्रयं कृत्वा त्रिधा स्वयम् ॥ 18 ॥
17.m: Then, in the middle of a direction of the kuṇḍa, O best of the twice-born, he should make a navel, / resembling a leaf of the sacred fig tree, positioned above the mekhala. // 22

17.s:
rāśīnāṃ bhagavānviṣṇurlokānugrahakṛtsthitaḥ |
aṅkuśādvainateyāntaṃ sthūlātsthūlamidaṃ trikam || 19 ||
17.d:
राशीनां भगवान्विष्णुर्लोकानुग्रहकृत्स्थितः ।
अङ्कुशाद्वैनतेयान्तं स्थूलात्स्थूलमिदं त्रिकम् ॥ 19 ॥
17.m: Combining together that entire measurement of the mekhalas / which was previously stated by me in order, he should mark it from the center with a cord. // 23

17.s:
gadāmantrācca śaṅkhāntaṃ sthūlamadhyaṃ ca nārada |
paṅkajātkaustubhāntaṃ ca sthūlapāraṃ bhavettrikam || 20 ||
17.d:
गदामन्त्राच्च शङ्खान्तं स्थूलमध्यं च नारद ।
पङ्कजात्कौस्तुभान्तं च स्थूलपारं भवेत्त्रिकम् ॥ 20 ॥
17.m: [Shaped] like a half-moon at the outside by half, and prominently there, / he should diminish it by this procedure from the mouth up to the interior, // 24

17.s:
varāhātsiṃhmamantrāntaṃ sūkṣma sthūlaṃ trikaṃ smṛtam |
astrāddhṛdayaparyantaṃ sūkṣmamadhyo bhavetprabhuḥ || 21 ||
17.d:
वराहात्सिंह्ममन्त्रान्तं सूक्ष्म स्थूलं त्रिकं स्मृतम् ।
अस्त्राद्धृदयपर्यन्तं सूक्ष्ममध्यो भवेत्प्रभुः ॥ 21 ॥
17.m: on both flanks, O brahmin, shaped like an elephant's lip; / at the back it should be made slightly elevated above the mekhala's height, O twice-born. // 25

17.s:
māyāśaktestu lakṣmyantaṃ bhavetsūkṣmaṃ paraṃ tu tat |
samūlo mūrtimantro yaḥ sarvassaptadaśākṣaraḥ || 22 ||
17.d:
मायाशक्तेस्तु लक्ष्म्यन्तं भवेत्सूक्ष्मं परं तु तत् ।
समूलो मूर्तिमन्त्रो यः सर्वस्सप्तदशाक्षरः ॥ 22 ॥
17.m: And from the measurement of one mekhala, by a third or a half, O sage, / he should diminish it gradually until it reaches the height of the mekhala. // 26

17.s:
parasthūlamidaṃ viddhi saptamaṃ sarvasiddhidam |
aniruddhāttu satyāntaṃ sarvaṃ tatparamadhyamam || 23 ||
17.d:
परस्थूलमिदं विद्धि सप्तमं सर्वसिद्धिदम् ।
अनिरुद्धात्तु सत्यान्तं सर्वं तत्परमध्यमम् ॥ 23 ॥
17.m: It should be slightly elevated, situated upon the mekhala; / having the measurement of a fourth part of one mekhala inside the kuṇḍa, O twice-born, // 27

17.s:
parātparaṃ mantrapadaṃ navamaṃ bhogamokṣadam |
viddhi saptākṣaraṃ piṇḍaṃ mantragrāmasya nāyakam || 24 ||
17.d:
परात्परं मन्त्रपदं नवमं भोगमोक्षदम् ।
विद्धि सप्ताक्षरं पिण्डं मन्त्रग्रामस्य नायकम् ॥ 24 ॥
17.m: he should make it project into the yoni, and descending downward, / traversing the surface of the mekhala until it touches the excavation. // 28

17.s:
uttarottaratā caiva sarveṣāṃ vartate kramāt |
sāmarthyena tu vīryeṇa jñānena vividhena ca || 25 ||
17.d:
उत्तरोत्तरता चैव सर्वेषां वर्तते क्रमात् ।
सामर्थ्येन तु वीर्येण ज्ञानेन विविधेन च ॥ 25 ॥
17.m: Thus has the characteristic of the navel been declared as it is; / know the preparation of the square kuṇḍa as sacrificial. // 29

17.s: bhavacchede ca dīkṣāyāṃ vividhāsu ca siddhiṣu |
17.d: भवच्छेदे च दीक्षायां विविधासु च सिद्धिषु ।
17.m: Having placed a cord in the center of the square and then made a rotation, / he should make a uniform square, devoid of corners in all directions. // 30

17.s:
[mantrasaṅghasya tattvasaṅghe
saṃkṣepamadhyavistārātmakadīkṣātraividhyānuguṇaṃ
tredhā'vasthānanirūpaṇam]
17.d:
[मन्त्रसङ्घस्य तत्त्वसङ्घे
संक्षेपमध्यविस्तारात्मकदीक्षात्रैविध्यानुगुणं
त्रेधाऽवस्थाननिरूपणम्]
17.m: [Options for kuṇḍas]

17.s: krameṇa gandhatanmātrātprabhutattvāvadhiṃ dvija || 26 ||
17.d: क्रमेण गन्धतन्मात्रात्प्रभुतत्त्वावधिं द्विज ॥ 26 ॥
17.m: In daily and occasional oblations, [the kuṇḍa may be] circular or square, / made with three mekhalas, endowed with a lip and a navel, // 31

17.s:
mantrasaṅghaḥ paratvena kiñcitsaṅkocarūpadhṛt |
sthūlasūkṣmādi navadhā madhye vistārakarmaṇi || 27 ||
17.d:
मन्त्रसङ्घः परत्वेन किञ्चित्सङ्कोचरूपधृत् ।
स्थूलसूक्ष्मादि नवधा मध्ये विस्तारकर्मणि ॥ 27 ॥
17.m: or with two mekhalas, O foremost of brahmins, very smooth and charming, / or a kuṇḍa with a single mekhala in a rite of casting off. // 32

17.s:
bhayo'nukramayogena pañcaviṃśatidhā mune |
ekaḥ sa eva mantrātmā bhinno'pi bahubhedataḥ || 28 ||
17.d:
भयोऽनुक्रमयोगेन पञ्चविंशतिधा मुने ।
एकः स एव मन्त्रात्मा भिन्नोऽपि बहुभेदतः ॥ 28 ॥
17.m: [The excellence of offering in a kuṇḍa]

17.s:
p. 157) [adhibhūtādhidaivādhyātmabhedena tredhā vibhinnasya pratyekaṃ
pañcaviṃśatidhā'vasthitinirūpaṇam]
17.d:
प्। 157) [अधिभूताधिदैवाध्यात्मभेदेन त्रेधा विभिन्नस्य प्रत्येकं
पञ्चविंशतिधाऽवस्थितिनिरूपणम्]
17.m: He may make it movable or fixed; for without a kuṇḍa, / the offering of mantras is not auspicious, O brahmin; therefore he should prepare a kuṇḍa. // 33

17.s:
adhyātmatvādhidaivatvādhibhūtatvavyavasthayā |
sthitastvīśvaratattvācca yāvattattvaṃ dharābhidham || 29 ||
17.d:
अध्यात्मत्वाधिदैवत्वाधिभूतत्वव्यवस्थया ।
स्थितस्त्वीश्वरतत्त्वाच्च यावत्तत्त्वं धराभिधम् ॥ 29 ॥
17.m: [Method of oblation when a kuṇḍa is impossible due to deficiency of place and time]

17.s:
īśvaro'tha pradhānaṃ ca buddhiścāhaṃkṛtirmanaḥ |
pañcendriyāṇi śrotrādyāḥ pañca vāgādayastathā || 30 ||
17.d:
ईश्वरोऽथ प्रधानं च बुद्धिश्चाहंकृतिर्मनः ।
पञ्चेन्द्रियाणि श्रोत्राद्याः पञ्च वागादयस्तथा ॥ 30 ॥
17.m: If a kuṇḍa cannot be produced on account of place and time, / an interruption of the offering must not be made without it by one desiring success. // 34

17.s:
pañca śabdādayaścānye pañca bhūtāni khādayaḥ |
adhibhūtagaṇaścāyamadhidaivagaṇaṃ śṛṇu || 31 ||
17.d:
पञ्च शब्दादयश्चान्ये पञ्च भूतानि खादयः ।
अधिभूतगणश्चायमधिदैवगणं शृणु ॥ 31 ॥
17.m: On a purified and smeared ground supplied with soft earth, / the oblation of the mantra, consecrated by mantra, is duly prescribed. // 35

17.s:
makārādyāni bījāni kāvasānāni vai kramāt |
īśvarādiṣu tattveṣu kathitāssādhidaivatāḥ || 32 ||
17.d:
मकाराद्यानि बीजानि कावसानानि वै क्रमात् ।
ईश्वरादिषु तत्त्वेषु कथितास्साधिदैवताः ॥ 32 ॥
17.m: A square base outside is praised everywhere; / in the middle he should make a lotus, an auspicious lotus situated within the lotus. // 36

17.s:
mantrāścādhyātmarūpā ye kramaśaḥ śṛṇu nārada |
saptākṣaraḥ paro mantro hyadhyātmaṃ caiśvaraṃ smṛtam || 33 ||
17.d:
मन्त्राश्चाध्यात्मरूपा ये क्रमशः शृणु नारद ।
सप्ताक्षरः परो मन्त्रो ह्यध्यात्मं चैश्वरं स्मृतम् ॥ 33 ॥
17.m: When an auspicious kuṇḍa has been thus made, he should perform the fire ritual; / or, if in a building other than the sacrificial pavilion, O great sage, // 37

17.s:
satyādipañcakaṃ viddhi prakṛte paramavyayam |
mūlamūrtisametaṃ ca buddheradhyātmamucyate || 34 ||
17.d:
सत्यादिपञ्चकं विद्धि प्रकृते परमव्ययम् ।
मूलमूर्तिसमेतं च बुद्धेरध्यात्ममुच्यते ॥ 34 ॥
17.m: he should perform the door-sacrifice as before and then enter; / or if he performs it right there, having placed another auspicious seat, // 38

17.s:
lakṣmīmantramahaṅkāre manasaḥ kīrtisaṃjñitam |
śrotrendriye jayākhyaṃ tu māyākhyaṃ ca tvagindriye || 35 ||
17.d:
लक्ष्मीमन्त्रमहङ्कारे मनसः कीर्तिसंज्ञितम् ।
श्रोत्रेन्द्रिये जयाख्यं तु मायाख्यं च त्वगिन्द्रिये ॥ 35 ॥
17.m: having seated himself there according to the previously stated rule, concentrated in mind:

17.s:
hṛccakṣurindriye viddhi jihvāgre tu śiraḥ smṛtam |
śikhā ghrāṇendriye viddhi vāktatve kavacaṃ smṛtam || 36 ||
17.d:
हृच्चक्षुरिन्द्रिये विद्धि जिह्वाग्रे तु शिरः स्मृतम् ।
शिखा घ्राणेन्द्रिये विद्धि वाक्तत्वे कवचं स्मृतम् ॥ 36 ॥
17.m: [Method of consecration of the kuṇḍa]

17.s:
pāṇitattve bhavennetramastraṃ pādābhidhasya ca |
pāyvākhyasya ca tattvasya sihmamantraṃ paraṃ smṛtam || 37 ||
17.d:
पाणितत्त्वे भवेन्नेत्रमस्त्रं पादाभिधस्य च ।
पाय्वाख्यस्य च तत्त्वस्य सिह्ममन्त्रं परं स्मृतम् ॥ 37 ॥
17.m: If the consecrations were not performed at the time of beginning the kuṇḍa, // 39

17.s:
kāpilaṃ viddhyupasthasya śabde vārāha ucyate |
sparśe tvadhyātmarūpaṃ ca mantraṃ kaustubhasaṃjñitam || 38 ||
17.d:
कापिलं विद्ध्युपस्थस्य शब्दे वाराह उच्यते ।
स्पर्शे त्वध्यात्मरूपं च मन्त्रं कौस्तुभसंज्ञितम् ॥ 38 ॥
17.m: they must all be performed in sequence once it is finished. / He should strike [it] with the weapon-mantra, with flowers in his right hand; // 40

17.s:
rūpākhyasya tu mālākhyaṃ padmaṃ viddhi rasasya ca |
śaṅkhamantrastu gandhasya cakraṃ nabhasi nārada || 39 ||
17.d:
रूपाख्यस्य तु मालाख्यं पद्मं विद्धि रसस्य च ।
शङ्खमन्त्रस्तु गन्धस्य चक्रं नभसि नारद ॥ 39 ॥
17.m: and taking a particle of earth from one part of the center of the kuṇḍa / with the thumb and ring finger, he should lift it out with the heart[-mantra]; // 41

17.s:
gadāmantraḥ smṛto vāyoragnergāruḍa ucyate |
aptattvasya tu pāśākhyo bhūmeraṅkuśasaṃjñitaḥ || 40 ||
17.d:
गदामन्त्रः स्मृतो वायोरग्नेर्गारुड उच्यते ।
अप्तत्त्वस्य तु पाशाख्यो भूमेरङ्कुशसंज्ञितः ॥ 40 ॥
17.m: leveling [it] with the weapon[-mantra] so that it is neither depressed nor elevated, / he should sprinkle it with the armour[-mantra] and pound it immediately thereafter; // 42

17.s:
vaitatyenoditā mantrāḥ satattvā vitate krame |
dīkṣākarmaṇi saṃkṣipte madhyame vitate'tha ca || 41 ||
17.d:
वैतत्येनोदिता मन्त्राः सतत्त्वा वितते क्रमे ।
दीक्षाकर्मणि संक्षिप्ते मध्यमे विततेऽथ च ॥ 41 ॥
17.m: he should smear it with scented water, purify it with the weapon[-mantra], / and carefully trace lines with the king of weapons using a stalk of darbha grass. // 43

17.s:
yāvanna tritayaṃ jñātaṃ tāvaddīkṣā na jāyate |
evameṣa jagannātho mantrātmā parameśvaraḥ || 42 ||
17.d:
यावन्न त्रितयं ज्ञातं तावद्दीक्षा न जायते ।
एवमेष जगन्नाथो मन्त्रात्मा परमेश्वरः ॥ 42 ॥
17.m: On the ground inside the kuṇḍa, in sequence from the southern quarter / up to the northern quarter, he should make three equal lines; // 44

17.s:
p. 158) pañcaviṃśatitattveṣu tattvabījeṣu caiva hi |
sthito hyadhiṣṭhātṛtvena paratvena mahāmate || 43 ||
17.d:
प्। 158) पञ्चविंशतितत्त्वेषु तत्त्वबीजेषु चैव हि ।
स्थितो ह्यधिष्ठातृत्वेन परत्वेन महामते ॥ 43 ॥
17.m: beginning from the western section, he should carry them facing east; / in their middle [he should make] another triad of lines facing north. // 45

17.s:
ūrdhve saptākṣaraṃ vipra sthitā nārāyaṇī sthitiḥ |
yā hyeva kathitā pūrvaṃ tridhā saiva tu nānyathā || 44 ||
17.d:
ऊर्ध्वे सप्ताक्षरं विप्र स्थिता नारायणी स्थितिः ।
या ह्येव कथिता पूर्वं त्रिधा सैव तु नान्यथा ॥ 44 ॥
17.m: Having drawn the lines thus according to rule, he should sprinkle [them] with the armour[-mantra], / and then with unbroken-tipped darbha grasses consecrated with the weapon-mantra // 46

17.s:
[tathābhūtasya mantrātmanaḥ parameśvarasya viśeṣatastryakṣare mantre
sānnidhyanirūpaṇam]
17.d:
[तथाभूतस्य मन्त्रात्मनः परमेश्वरस्य विशेषतस्त्र्यक्षरे मन्त्रे
सान्निध्यनिरूपणम्]
17.m: he should adorn all the raised walls of the kuṇḍa. / Having thus made an enclosure, the excellent preparation of the kuṇḍa [is complete]. // 47

17.s:
sthitīssarvāśca saṃhṛtya viśeṣeṇa vyavasthitaḥ |
paraṃ(ra ?)sūkṣmayutaṃ(ta ?)sthūlarūpeṇa tryakṣare sadā || 45 ||
17.d:
स्थितीस्सर्वाश्च संहृत्य विशेषेण व्यवस्थितः ।
परं(र ?)सूक्ष्मयुतं(त ?)स्थूलरूपेण त्र्यक्षरे सदा ॥ 45 ॥
17.m: [Worship of the navel]

17.s: mantre hyanugrahārthastu bhavitā bhāvitātmanām |
17.d: मन्त्रे ह्यनुग्रहार्थस्तु भविता भावितात्मनाम् ।
17.m: Then, having worshipped in the centre with arghya and the like using the praṇava, / he should worship according to the same rule the navel resembling the moon. // 48

17.s:
[vakṣyamāṇadīkṣāṅgabhūtatvattvaśodhane tryakṣarasya mantrasya
viniyogabhedaḥ]
17.d:
[वक्ष्यमाणदीक्षाङ्गभूतत्वत्त्वशोधने त्र्यक्षरस्य मन्त्रस्य
विनियोगभेदः]
17.m: [Worship of the mekhalās]

17.s: triruccāreṇa vai kuryāddīkṣāṃ vā tena nārada || 46 ||
17.d: त्रिरुच्चारेण वै कुर्याद्दीक्षां वा तेन नारद ॥ 46 ॥
17.m: In the worship of the triad of mekhalās he should employ the heart-mantra.

17.s:
īśapradhānatanmātrasandhāne śodhane sati |
dviruccāreṇa vā kuryādīśaprakṛtiyogataḥ || 47 ||
17.d:
ईशप्रधानतन्मात्रसन्धाने शोधने सति ।
द्विरुच्चारेण वा कुर्यादीशप्रकृतियोगतः ॥ 47 ॥
17.m: [Worship of the triad of principles on the triad of mekhalās]

17.s: prakṛtirdvyakṣaro(re ?)śodhyā praṇaveneśvarastathā |
17.d: प्रकृतिर्द्व्यक्षरो(रे ?)शोध्या प्रणवेनेश्वरस्तथा ।
17.m: Then the triad of principles is to be worshipped upon the triad of mekhalās: // 49

17.s: [saptākṣaramantreṇeśvaratattvasaṃśodhanaprakāraḥ sopapattikaḥ]
17.d: [सप्ताक्षरमन्त्रेणेश्वरतत्त्वसंशोधनप्रकारः सोपपत्तिकः]
17.m: namely, Pradhāna, Puruṣa, and Īśa, along with the triad of praṇavas. / Having previously worshipped the kuṇḍa with offerings of arghya, unguents, and incense, O twice-born, // 50

17.s: saptārṇeneśvaraṃ vātha ekoccāreṇa śodhayet || 48 ||
17.d: सप्तार्णेनेश्वरं वाथ एकोच्चारेण शोधयेत् ॥ 48 ॥
17.m: [Procedure for establishing the power called Nārāyaṇa after arranging the seat beginning with the supporting power in the middle of the kuṇḍa]

17.s:
mantrā yato'khilāstasminpiṇḍe tattvāni ceśvare |
ityevaṃ viṣṇutattvaṃ tu vyāpakatvena saṃsthitam || 49 ||
17.d:
मन्त्रा यतोऽखिलास्तस्मिन्पिण्डे तत्त्वानि चेश्वरे ।
इत्येवं विष्णुतत्त्वं तु व्यापकत्वेन संस्थितम् ॥ 49 ॥
17.m: he should place a seat of darbha grass along with flowers at the intersection situated in the kuṇḍa / with the heart-mantra, and then worship upon it. // 51

17.s:
jñātvā samyaktato dīkṣāṃ mantraiḥ kuryāddvijākhilaiḥ |
yataḥ pareṇa vibhunā sarve mantrā adhiṣṭhitāḥ || 50 ||
17.d:
ज्ञात्वा सम्यक्ततो दीक्षां मन्त्रैः कुर्याद्द्विजाखिलैः ।
यतः परेण विभुना सर्वे मन्त्रा अधिष्ठिताः ॥ 50 ॥
17.m: Having worshipped [it], taking the fire, carrying [it] thrice around the precinct, / and depositing it by way of the yoni, he should remember the seed-syllable of fire. // 52

17.s: [śiṣyalakṣaṇaparīkṣaṇapūrvakaṃ śiṣyāṇāṃ dīkṣitavyatā]
17.d: [शिष्यलक्षणपरीक्षणपूर्वकं शिष्याणां दीक्षितव्यता]
17.m: And on the Vaiṣṇava seat which begins with the supporting power, / there [he visualises] the power named Nārāyaṇa, characterised by radiance, // 53

17.s:
parīkṣya tanniyuktāṃstu brahmacaryasthitān śucīn |
dakṣān jitendriyāndhīrāngurudevāgnitatparān || 51 ||
17.d:
परीक्ष्य तन्नियुक्तांस्तु ब्रह्मचर्यस्थितान् शुचीन् ।
दक्षान् जितेन्द्रियान्धीरान्गुरुदेवाग्नितत्परान् ॥ 51 ॥
17.m: which has attained the state of the form of Lakṣmī, whose body is enveloped in nectar, / having a form supreme above all, endowed with all powers, // 54

17.s:
varṇāśramaguṇopetānvinītān śraddhayā'nvitān |
śiṣyāṃśca bhagavadbhaktān saṃsārānalakheditān || 52 ||
17.d:
वर्णाश्रमगुणोपेतान्विनीतान् श्रद्धयाऽन्वितान् ।
शिष्यांश्च भगवद्भक्तान् संसारानलखेदितान् ॥ 52 ॥
17.m: abiding within all entities through her delicate form, / eternal; having brought her down into the heart-lotus by the path of creation, // 55

17.s:
dīkṣayedvidhinā mantrī mantradīkṣāditaḥ kramāt |
saṃsthitā'nekabhedena yathā tadgadataḥ śṛṇu || 53 ||
17.d:
दीक्षयेद्विधिना मन्त्री मन्त्रदीक्षादितः क्रमात् ।
संस्थिताऽनेकभेदेन यथा तद्गदतः शृणु ॥ 53 ॥
17.m: previously in the sequence of meditation, from the heart-lotus by means of the heart-mantra, / joined with the word of her own name, preceded by the praṇava and namaḥ, // 56

17.s: [sāmānyadīkṣāyāstraividhyam]
17.d: [सामान्यदीक्षायास्त्रैविध्यम्]
17.m: emitting [her] with the exhalation into the centre of the heart-lotus of the kuṇḍa, / having worshipped her with scent, flowers, and the like, and having shown the lotus-mudrā, // 57

17.s:
sarveṣāṃ kevalairmantrairmāntrī sāmānyalakṣaṇā |
tattvairbījaistathā mantrairdhyānena havanena ca || 54 ||
17.d:
सर्वेषां केवलैर्मन्त्रैर्मान्त्री सामान्यलक्षणा ।
तत्त्वैर्बीजैस्तथा मन्त्रैर्ध्यानेन हवनेन च ॥ 54 ॥
17.m: he should thus bring about her presence, joined with the discus-mantra.

17.s:
p. 159) sāmānyā hi(tri ?)vidhā cānyā sarveṣā bhāvitātmanām |
saṃkṣiptā madhyamā sā ca tṛtīyā cātivistarā || 55 ||
17.d:
प्। 159) सामान्या हि(त्रि ?)विधा चान्या सर्वेषा भावितात्मनाम् ।
संक्षिप्ता मध्यमा सा च तृतीया चातिविस्तरा ॥ 55 ॥
17.m: [The sequence of producing the fire]

17.s: [saṃkṣiptāditrayasya phalabhedaḥ]
17.d: [संक्षिप्तादित्रयस्य फलभेदः]
17.m: And at the beginning, for the generation of the Lord's power as fire, // 58

17.s:
ka(a ?)lpakālaṃ ca saṃkṣiptā bhogaṃ yacchati saṅkaṭam |
madhyamā madhyamaṃ bhogaṃ tathā kālaṃ prayacchati || 56 ||
17.d:
क(अ ?)ल्पकालं च संक्षिप्ता भोगं यच्छति सङ्कटम् ।
मध्यमा मध्यमं भोगं तथा कालं प्रयच्छति ॥ 56 ॥
17.m: taking fire produced from fire-sticks, or arising from a sun-gem, / or produced from iron and stone, or unpolluted common [fire], // 59

17.s:
anantabhogaphaladā bhavedbhogābhilāṣiṇām |
prabhāvāddhomapūjābhyāṃ vistīrṇā kālamakṣayam || 57 ||
17.d:
अनन्तभोगफलदा भवेद्भोगाभिलाषिणाम् ।
प्रभावाद्धोमपूजाभ्यां विस्तीर्णा कालमक्षयम् ॥ 57 ॥
17.m: in a vessel made of bell-metal or of copper, or in a fresh earthen one,

17.s: samatvamapavarge tu bhaveddīkṣātrayasya ca |
17.d: समत्वमपवर्गे तु भवेद्दीक्षात्रयस्य च ।
17.m: [The five external consecrations of the fire, such as striking and sprinkling]

17.s: [viśeṣadīkṣāyāḥ pañcavidhatvam]
17.d: [विशेषदीक्षायाः पञ्चविधत्वम्]
17.m: having struck it with the weapon-mantra, he should sprinkle it with the śikhā[-mantra]; // 60

17.s: viśeṣākhyā ca yā dīkṣā pañcadhā sā vyavasthitā || 58 ||
17.d: विशेषाख्या च या दीक्षा पञ्चधा सा व्यवस्थिता ॥ 58 ॥
17.m: he should worship it with the armour[-mantra], veil it with the armour[-mantra], / and flood it with nectar using the eye-mantra, O Nārada. // 61

17.s: [pañcavidhāsu viśeṣadīkṣāsu pratyekamadhikāribhedanirūpaṇam]
17.d: [पञ्चविधासु विशेषदीक्षासु प्रत्येकमधिकारिभेदनिरूपणम्]
17.m: [Contemplation of the fire reaching the navel after bringing it to rest within oneself and bringing it down stage by stage via the sequence of creation]

17.s:
prathamā samayajñānāṃ balānāṃ viṣṇucetasām |
bhaktānāṃ kanyakānāṃ ca dvitīyā putrakeṣu ca || 59 ||
17.d:
प्रथमा समयज्ञानां बलानां विष्णुचेतसाम् ।
भक्तानां कन्यकानां च द्वितीया पुत्रकेषु च ॥ 59 ॥
17.m: Then, drawing it in with the inhalation, he should bring it to rest within himself; / having raised it as before, he should unite it gradually with the power of bliss. // 62

17.s:
tṛtīyā mokṣamārgasthā sādhakānāṃ tu vai sadā |
caturthī muniśārdūla brahmasāyujyadāyikā || 60 ||
17.d:
तृतीया मोक्षमार्गस्था साधकानां तु वै सदा ।
चतुर्थी मुनिशार्दूल ब्रह्मसायुज्यदायिका ॥ 60 ॥
17.m: Bringing it down again step by step according to the sequence of creation, / down to the domain of sound, he should then contemplate it situated in the navel. // 63

17.s: deśikānāṃ tu kartavyā aṅganānāṃ tu pañcamī |
17.d: देशिकानां तु कर्तव्या अङ्गनानां तु पञ्चमी ।
17.m: [The procedure of offering oblation into the special light visualised as present in the navel-kuṇḍa]

17.s:
[saṃkṣiptamadhyamavistṛtabhedabhinnāsu sāmānyadīkṣāsu
kramāttatvasaṃyojanaprakārabhedaḥ]
17.d:
[संक्षिप्तमध्यमविस्तृतभेदभिन्नासु सामान्यदीक्षासु
क्रमात्तत्वसंयोजनप्रकारभेदः]
17.m: With the praṇava he should worship the one residing in the navel, whose nature is fire and soma, / divided into three with kindling sticks, respectfully with the initial [syllables] a, da [ha], and the like. // 64

17.s: etāsāṃ kramaśo vakṣye samatvaṃ tattvasaṃgraham || 61 ||
17.d: एतासां क्रमशो वक्ष्ये समत्वं तत्त्वसंग्रहम् ॥ 61 ॥
17.m: Then, O twice-born, he should worship with the differentiated seed-syllables of the three, / so that by the offering of a single oblation, he who resides there is awakened. // 65

17.s:
yena vijñātamātreṇa dīkṣā samyakpravartate |
saṃhārakramayogena mantrarāśitrayaṃ ca yat || 62 ||
17.d:
येन विज्ञातमात्रेण दीक्षा सम्यक्प्रवर्तते ।
संहारक्रमयोगेन मन्त्रराशित्रयं च यत् ॥ 62 ॥
17.m: Having meditated in his heart on the nectar of clarified butter, he should recite by that path.

17.s:
prāguktaṃ yojanīyaṃ tattṛtīye(tritayaṃ ?) bījasaṃyute(tam ?) |
tanmātrake pradhāne ca īśvarākhye ca śuddhaye || 63 ||
17.d:
प्रागुक्तं योजनीयं तत्तृतीये(त्रितयं ?) बीजसंयुते(तम् ?) ।
तन्मात्रके प्रधाने च ईश्वराख्ये च शुद्धये ॥ 63 ॥
17.m: [Raising of that fire from the navel-kuṇḍa by its own mantra]

17.s:
rāśitrayasya yo bhedaḥ kathito navadhā purā |
aṅkuśātsaptavarṇāntaṃ tanmātreṣu ca pañcasu || 64 ||
17.d:
राशित्रयस्य यो भेदः कथितो नवधा पुरा ।
अङ्कुशात्सप्तवर्णान्तं तन्मात्रेषु च पञ्चसु ॥ 64 ॥
17.m: Then the fire is to be raised from the navel-kuṇḍa with its own mantra. // 66

17.s:
ahaṅkāre tathā buddhau prakṛtau ceśvare ca vai |
tayā saṃhṛtiyuktyā vai gandhamātrāditaḥ kramāt || 65 ||
17.d:
अहङ्कारे तथा बुद्धौ प्रकृतौ चेश्वरे च वै ।
तया संहृतियुक्त्या वै गन्धमात्रादितः क्रमात् ॥ 65 ॥
17.m: [The mantra of fire]

17.s:
vistīrṇāyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ yadadhyātmādinoditam |
kramaḥ sa eva boddhavyaḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhārayogataḥ || 66 ||
17.d:
विस्तीर्णायां तृतीयायां यदध्यात्मादिनोदितम् ।
क्रमः स एव बोद्धव्यः सृष्टिसंहारयोगतः ॥ 66 ॥
17.m: Having placed the praṇava at the beginning, O Brahmin, after it he should install "ajita"; / then above it he should add "aśeṣabhuvanādhāram". // 67

17.s: sāmānyatritayasyedaṃ dīkṣāyogasya lakṣaṇam |
17.d: सामान्यत्रितयस्येदं दीक्षायोगस्य लक्षणम् ।
17.m: And above and below it he should place "bhūdhara" and "ūrj"; / on the head of this seed-syllable, O wise one, [he places] that which bestows the sovereignty of the three worlds. // 68

17.s:
[atha viśeṣadīkṣāpañcakabhede pratyekaṃ
mantraistattvasaṃyojanaprakārabhedaḥ]
17.d:
[अथ विशेषदीक्षापञ्चकभेदे प्रत्येकं
मन्त्रैस्तत्त्वसंयोजनप्रकारभेदः]
17.m: Then, having combined in sequence the group of seven beginning with "dhareśa" / and ending with the name "suparṇa", he should join to this group of seven // 69

17.s: pañcakasyādhunā viddhi viśeṣākhyasya nārada || 67 ||
17.d: पञ्चकस्याधुना विद्धि विशेषाख्यस्य नारद ॥ 67 ॥
17.m: the stalk above and below, and above [that] the māyā-space; / having taken the word "tejase", then the word "saptārciṣe", // 70

17.s:
p. 160) tryakṣaraṃ padabhedena mūrtimantrasamanvitam |
saṃkṣipte tattvajāle tu yojanīyaṃ krameṇa tu || 68 ||
17.d:
प्। 160) त्र्यक्षरं पदभेदेन मूर्तिमन्त्रसमन्वितम् ।
संक्षिप्ते तत्त्वजाले तु योजनीयं क्रमेण तु ॥ 68 ॥
17.m: and accompanied by "svāhā", is the eighteen-syllable mantra of fire.

17.s:
tanmātrāṇāṃ ca hrīṃ svāhā pañcānāṃ tu sakṛnnyaset |
viśvātmane padaṃ yacca dvitīyaṃ tadahaṅkṛtau || 69 ||
17.d:
तन्मात्राणां च ह्रीं स्वाहा पञ्चानां तु सकृन्न्यसेत् ।
विश्वात्मने पदं यच्च द्वितीयं तदहङ्कृतौ ॥ 69 ॥
17.m: [Casting the splendour awakened from the navel-kuṇḍa with its own mantra into the fire in the vessel]

17.s:
nārāyaṇāya buddhau tu tṛtīyaṃ yojane(yet ?)smaran |
namaḥ pradhānatatve tu tryakṣaraṃ ceśvare tataḥ || 70 ||
17.d:
नारायणाय बुद्धौ तु तृतीयं योजने(येत् ?)स्मरन् ।
नमः प्रधानतत्वे तु त्र्यक्षरं चेश्वरे ततः ॥ 70 ॥
17.m: Terminating in the bodily sound of roaring, awakened by the perception of the pure sound, // 71

17.s:
viśeṣapañcakasyaiṣā prathamā parikīrtitā |
dvitīyaṃ śṛṇu viprendra sarvasiddhipradā hi yā || 71 ||
17.d:
विशेषपञ्चकस्यैषा प्रथमा परिकीर्तिता ।
द्वितीयं शृणु विप्रेन्द्र सर्वसिद्धिप्रदा हि या ॥ 71 ॥
17.m: free from the smoke of conceptual thought, with sparks of pure consciousness, / he should cast it, O Brahmin, with the end of the sound (nādānta) through the path of perfection, as before. // 72

17.s:
gandhatanmātrapūrvāṇi hṛdayādyairanukramāt |
ahaṅkāraṃ tu netreṇa (?) buddhiṃ jīvena śodhayet || 72 ||
17.d:
गन्धतन्मात्रपूर्वाणि हृदयाद्यैरनुक्रमात् ।
अहङ्कारं तु नेत्रेण (?) बुद्धिं जीवेन शोधयेत् ॥ 72 ॥
17.m: And into the fire previously taken in the vessel, for purification of the fire, / taking [it] with both hands and circling it, he should deposit it in the kuṇḍa. // 73

17.s:
pradhānaṃ madhyamenaiva devīnāṃ hṛdayena tu |
īśvaraṃ praṇavenaiva kuryāttatraiva yojanam || 73 ||
17.d:
प्रधानं मध्यमेनैव देवीनां हृदयेन तु ।
ईश्वरं प्रणवेनैव कुर्यात्तत्रैव योजनम् ॥ 73 ॥
17.m: [Specific visualisation of the fire cast into the kuṇḍa]

17.s:
putrakāṇāṃ smṛtā dīkṣā vidhinā'nena nārada |
sādhakānāṃ tu vakṣyāmi tattvaśuddhau krameṇa tu || 74 ||
17.d:
पुत्रकाणां स्मृता दीक्षा विधिनाऽनेन नारद ।
साधकानां तु वक्ष्यामि तत्त्वशुद्धौ क्रमेण तु ॥ 74 ॥
17.m: And he should visualise that fire, having entered his own heart, / inhaled through the tip of the nose by the power named Nārāyaṇa situated in the centre of the kuṇḍa. // 74

17.s:
saṃśodhya gandhatanmātraṃ vaktramantratrayeṇa tu |
rasākhyamaṅgaṣaṭkena rūpamātraṃ ca śaktibhiḥ || 75 ||
17.d:
संशोध्य गन्धतन्मात्रं वक्त्रमन्त्रत्रयेण तु ।
रसाख्यमङ्गषट्केन रूपमात्रं च शक्तिभिः ॥ 75 ॥
17.m: [Awakening of the fire]

17.s:
samastamūlamantreṇa śodhayetsparśasaṃjñitam |
saṃśodhya śabdatanmātramaniruddhena nārada || 76 ||
17.d:
समस्तमूलमन्त्रेण शोधयेत्स्पर्शसंज्ञितम् ।
संशोध्य शब्दतन्मात्रमनिरुद्धेन नारद ॥ 76 ॥
17.m: He should offer three, five, or seven kindling sticks with the heart[-mantra]; / and for the purpose of awakening the fire, [he offers] with the eye-mantra, O Nārada. // 75

17.s:
pradyumnena tvahaṅkāraṃ buddhiṃ saṅkarṣaṇena ca |
pradhānaṃ vāsudevena tataḥ satyena ceśvaram || 77 ||
17.d:
प्रद्युम्नेन त्वहङ्कारं बुद्धिं सङ्कर्षणेन च ।
प्रधानं वासुदेवेन ततः सत्येन चेश्वरम् ॥ 77 ॥
17.m: [Circling with fire]

17.s:
śodhayetsādhakasyaivaṃ tattvaṃ sadvaiṣṇavasya ca |
dīkṣārthaṃ tattvasaṃśuddhau gurormantrānatho śṛṇu || 78 ||
17.d:
शोधयेत्साधकस्यैवं तत्त्वं सद्वैष्णवस्य च ।
दीक्षार्थं तत्त्वसंशुद्धौ गुरोर्मन्त्रानथो शृणु ॥ 78 ॥
17.m: He should perform the circling with fire with the heart[-mantra], with wet hands.

17.s:
daśabhissāstramantraistu gandhamātraṃ tu saṃharet |
lokeśādyai rasākhyaṃ tu rūpākhyaṃ kaustubhādikaiḥ || 79 ||
17.d:
दशभिस्सास्त्रमन्त्रैस्तु गन्धमात्रं तु संहरेत् ।
लोकेशाद्यै रसाख्यं तु रूपाख्यं कौस्तुभादिकैः ॥ 79 ॥
17.m: [Spreading around of sacred grass]

17.s:
sparśasaṃjñaṃ tribhirvaktrairhṛdādyaiḥ śabdasaṃjñitam |
lakṣmyādyairapyahaṅkāraṃ buddhiṃ mūlena śodhayet || 80 ||
17.d:
स्पर्शसंज्ञं त्रिभिर्वक्त्रैर्हृदाद्यैः शब्दसंज्ञितम् ।
लक्ष्म्याद्यैरप्यहङ्कारं बुद्धिं मूलेन शोधयेत् ॥ 80 ॥
17.m: Then, with the weapon-mantra, [he makes] the grass-strewing in the four directions, threefold each, // 76

17.s:
pradhānamatha satyādyaiḥ pañcabhiḥ pariśodhya ca |
saptākṣareṇa mantreṇa śodhayedīśvaraṃ tataḥ || 81 ||
17.d:
प्रधानमथ सत्याद्यैः पञ्चभिः परिशोध्य च ।
सप्ताक्षरेण मन्त्रेण शोधयेदीश्वरं ततः ॥ 81 ॥
17.m: beginning in the east, so that the roots are covered by their tips; / he should always complete the grass-strewing to his own north. // 77

17.s:
krama eṣa hi dīkṣāyāmācāryāṇāmudāhṛtaḥ |
strīṇāṃ tu bhogasiddhyarthaṃ śṛṇu dīkṣākramaṃ mama || 82 ||
17.d:
क्रम एष हि दीक्षायामाचार्याणामुदाहृतः ।
स्त्रीणां तु भोगसिद्ध्यर्थं शृणु दीक्षाक्रमं मम ॥ 82 ॥
17.m: Then, having placed upon the grass-strewing whatever is useful for the fire ritual,

17.s:
p. 161) puruṣaṃ prathame tattve yojayedgandhasaṃjñite |
rasatanmātrasaṃjñe'tha sattyaṃ caiva dvitīyake || 83 ||
17.d:
प्। 161) पुरुषं प्रथमे तत्त्वे योजयेद्गन्धसंज्ञिते ।
रसतन्मात्रसंज्ञेऽथ सत्त्यं चैव द्वितीयके ॥ 83 ॥
17.m: [Procuring the implement-materials such as praṇītā vessel, kindling wood, sruc and sruva]

17.s:
acyutaṃ ca tṛtīye tu vāsudevaṃ caturthake |
sakalena tu rūpeṇa etadādau catuṣṭayam || 84 ||
17.d:
अच्युतं च तृतीये तु वासुदेवं चतुर्थके ।
सकलेन तु रूपेण एतदादौ चतुष्टयम् ॥ 84 ॥
17.m: namely, the pair of praṇītā vessels and the pair of bundles of kindling sticks, // 78

17.s:
yojanīyaṃ ca mantrāṇāṃ catustanmātraśuddhaye |
pañcamecāniruddhaṃ tu ṣaṣṭhe yojyaḥ punaḥ prabhuḥ || 85 ||
17.d:
योजनीयं च मन्त्राणां चतुस्तन्मात्रशुद्धये ।
पञ्चमेचानिरुद्धं तु षष्ठे योज्यः पुनः प्रभुः ॥ 85 ॥
17.m: as well as the pair of sruc and sruva, and likewise the vessel of clarified butter; / having sprinkled everything with the root-mantra and placed it on the grass-strewing, // 79

17.s:
pradyumnastu viśālākṣastataḥ saṅkarṣaṇaḥ pare |
niṣkalassaptame yojyo devyo yojyāstathā'ṣṭame || 86 ||
17.d:
प्रद्युम्नस्तु विशालाक्षस्ततः सङ्कर्षणः परे ।
निष्कलस्सप्तमे योज्यो देव्यो योज्यास्तथाऽष्टमे ॥ 86 ॥
17.m: having then filled the praṇītā vessel with water, / contemplating an excellent seat there, he should deposit it with the root-mantra of Viṣṇu. // 80

17.s:
navame tu mahātattve dhyāyennārāyaṇaṃ prabhum |
tryakṣareṇa tu mantreṇa tridaivatyaṃ jagadgurum || 87 ||
17.d:
नवमे तु महातत्त्वे ध्यायेन्नारायणं प्रभुम् ।
त्र्यक्षरेण तु मन्त्रेण त्रिदैवत्यं जगद्गुरुम् ॥ 87 ॥
17.m: Having thus established to the north the mantra of the lord of the sacrifice in the sacrifice,

17.s:
evaṃ tattvasamūhasthaṃ jñātvā mantragaṇaṃ purā |
prārabheta tato dīkṣāṃ suśubhe divase guruḥ || 88 ||
17.d:
एवं तत्त्वसमूहस्थं ज्ञात्वा मन्त्रगणं पुरा ।
प्रारभेत ततो दीक्षां सुशुभे दिवसे गुरुः ॥ 88 ॥
17.m: [Rules for the surrounding sticks]

17.s: [dīkṣāyāṃ praśastāstithayaḥ]
17.d: [दीक्षायां प्रशस्तास्तिथयः]
17.m: And then, O brahmin, he should place the surrounding sticks with the heart-mantra, // 81

17.s:
yadyapyuktā mayā vipra tithayaḥ pūjane purā |
tathā'pi dvādaśī śreṣṭhā dīkṣāyāṃ pūjane hareḥ || 89 ||
17.d:
यद्यप्युक्ता मया विप्र तिथयः पूजने पुरा ।
तथाऽपि द्वादशी श्रेष्ठा दीक्षायां पूजने हरेः ॥ 89 ॥
17.m: made of sacrificial wood, distinct, bearing leaves, measured at a cubit, / with a circumference of four barley-corns, for an abode measuring a cubit. // 82

17.s: sarvaṃ daśamyāmāhṛtya yāgopakaraṇaṃ tu vai |
17.d: सर्वं दशम्यामाहृत्य यागोपकरणं तु वै ।
17.m: For others, O best of the twice-born, the increase of the surrounding sticks is two digits, / up to a kuṇḍa of eight cubits; above this he should not make [them]. // 83

17.s: [snānādiniyamapūrvakaṃ yāgaśālāpraveśaḥ]
17.d: [स्नानादिनियमपूर्वकं यागशालाप्रवेशः]
17.m: [Worship of the world-protectors beginning with Brahmā]

17.s: prāgvatsnātvā samācamya kṛtanyāsassmareddharim || 90 ||
17.d: प्राग्वत्स्नात्वा समाचम्य कृतन्यासस्स्मरेद्धरिम् ॥ 90 ॥
17.m: He should then place seats upon them, on their back, with the heart[-mantra], O sage; / on their back he should always worship the world-protectors situated in their own directions: // 84

17.s: puṣpārghyatoyahastaśca saṃviśedyāgamandiram |
17.d: पुष्पार्घ्यतोयहस्तश्च संविशेद्यागमन्दिरम् ।
17.m: those beginning with Brahmā, Mahendra, and Rudra, with auspicious scents, flowers, and other offerings.

17.s:
[nṛsiṃhyamantrādibhirabhimantritānāṃ siddhārthakānāṃ
yāgaśālāyāṃ paritaḥ prakṣepaḥ]
17.d:
[नृसिंह्यमन्त्रादिभिरभिमन्त्रितानां सिद्धार्थकानां
यागशालायां परितः प्रक्षेपः]
17.m: [Procedure for the consecration of the sruc and sruva]

17.s: nṛsiṃhmamantreṇāstreṇa sacakreṇābhimantrya ca || 91 ||
17.d: नृसिंह्ममन्त्रेणास्त्रेण सचक्रेणाभिमन्त्र्य च ॥ 91 ॥
17.m: And [he performs] consecration for the sruc and sruva with kusa blades positioned on the tip of the upayāma. // 85

17.s: siddhārthakānkṣipetpaścādūrdhve'dho digvidukṣu ca |
17.d: सिद्धार्थकान्क्षिपेत्पश्चादूर्ध्वेऽधो दिग्विदुक्षु च ।
17.m: The sruva is to be purified twelve times with the weapon[-mantra] and with hot water; / likewise, O tiger among the twice-born, the sruc is to be purified in just two ways. // 86

17.s: [svamantreṇa gadāsthāpanam]
17.d: [स्वमन्त्रेण गदास्थापनम्]
17.m: Having washed the sruc and sruva in this manner, then with the śikhā-mantra / they are to be heated by the fire situated in the kuṇḍa.

17.s: prākārākāradehāṃ ca nānājvālāsamāvṛtām || 92 ||
17.d: प्राकाराकारदेहां च नानाज्वालासमावृताम् ॥ 92 ॥
17.m: [Characteristics of the sruc and sruva]

17.s: śaktirūpāṃ gadāṃ tatra svamantreṇa tu vinyaset |
17.d: शक्तिरूपां गदां तत्र स्वमन्त्रेण तु विन्यसेत् ।
17.m: The characteristics of the two are [now] stated: // 87

17.s:
[satyādyabhimantritena pañcagavyena tryakṣaramantreṇa
sarvadravyaprokṣaṇam]
17.d:
[सत्याद्यभिमन्त्रितेन पञ्चगव्येन त्र्यक्षरमन्त्रेण
सर्वद्रव्यप्रोक्षणम्]
17.m: The knower of mantras should first fashion wood measuring the length of his own arm / and six digits in breadth, for the realization of the divine sruc. // 88

17.s: pātre cābhinave kuryātsaṃmiśrasalilena ca || 93 ||
17.d: पात्रे चाभिनवे कुर्यात्संमिश्रसलिलेन च ॥ 93 ॥
17.m: The handle is said to be eight-sided, with two parts out of its length; / having made the measure two and a half digits, he should shape the remainder. // 89

17.s:
satyādipañcakenātha pañcagavyaṃ tu mantrayet |
tryakṣareṇa tu mūlena sarvaṃ saṃprokṣya tena vai || 94 ||
17.d:
सत्यादिपञ्चकेनाथ पञ्चगव्यं तु मन्त्रयेत् ।
त्र्यक्षरेण तु मूलेन सर्वं संप्रोक्ष्य तेन वै ॥ 94 ॥
17.m: At the root of the handle he should make an auspicious pot with an opening like a lotus, / so that the handle rests upon the pericarp, O best of sages, // 90

17.s: p. 162) kauśeyena pavitreṇa dhyāyamānastameva hi |
17.d: प्। 162) कौशेयेन पवित्रेण ध्यायमानस्तमेव हि ।
17.m: or having three folds, or a conch, so that the handle enters its mouth. / Having divided the part situated at the front into two equal portions with care, // 91

17.s: [kalaśavidhiḥ]
17.d: [कलशविधिः]

17.s: athādāya dṛḍhaṃ śubhramekarūpaṃ ca nirvraṇam || 95 ||
17.d: अथादाय दृढं शुभ्रमेकरूपं च निर्व्रणम् ॥ 95 ॥
17.m: Having made a rotation, he should then make a sunken hollow having the prescribed marks; / in its middle he should fashion a blooming lotus with upward-facing sprouts. // 93

17.s:
kalaśaṃ mṛṇmayaṃ ramyaṃ sauvarṇaṃ cātha rājatam |
ratnahāṭakasadgandhaphalasarvauṣadhīyutam || 96 ||
17.d:
कलशं मृण्मयं रम्यं सौवर्णं चाथ राजतम् ।
रत्नहाटकसद्गन्धफलसर्वौषधीयुतम् ॥ 96 ॥
17.m: Know that to be the ghee-receptacle, resembling seven or five palas; / and in the middle of the lotus, the pericarp with filaments is sunken. // 94

17.s:
śubhapādapaśākhāḍhyaṃ paṭṭasrakkaṇṭhabhūṣaṇam |
gālitodakasaṃpūrṇaṃ vāridhārānvitaṃ śubham || 97 ||
17.d:
शुभपादपशाखाढ्यं पट्टस्रक्कण्ठभूषणम् ।
गालितोदकसंपूर्णं वारिधारान्वितं शुभम् ॥ 97 ॥
17.m: Outside the eight-petalled lotus there is a twelve-spoked wheel; / and on the outside of the lotus a conch should be made at the four corners. // 20

17.s: candanādyupaliptaṃ ca paritaścārghyacarcitam |
17.d: चन्दनाद्युपलिप्तं च परितश्चार्घ्यचर्चितम् ।
17.m: Then, O sage, on both sides of the front portion, / one digit on each side is to be carved away; it is then to be divided into three. // 96

17.s: [yathāvidhi mantrasya sāṅgasya pūjanīyatvavidhānam]
17.d: [यथाविधि मन्त्रस्य साङ्गस्य पूजनीयत्वविधानम्]
17.m: The ear is one part, but in the middle the shoulders are two; / the face is separated from the shoulders by one digit in the middle. // 97

17.s: mantrapīṭhopari brahmansāṅgaṃ saparivārakam || 98 ||
17.d: मन्त्रपीठोपरि ब्रह्मन्साङ्गं सपरिवारकम् ॥ 98 ॥
17.m: First having set aside a width equal to the ear, / beginning from the region of the ear, he should carve the remainder // 98

17.s: mantraṃ pūrvoktavidhinā pūjayecca yathāvidhi |
17.d: मन्त्रं पूर्वोक्तविधिना पूजयेच्च यथाविधि ।
17.m: with a cord applied in succession, so that it becomes like the snout of a boar. / Then, from the lotus leaf right up to the tip of the mouth, // 99

17.s: [vardhanyā abhimantraṇam]
17.d: [वर्धन्या अभिमन्त्रणम्]
17.m: he should make the channel for the ghee, even, measuring less than a digit, O sage, / and slightly tapering gradually, so that the ghee does not flow swiftly. // 100

17.s: sāstreṇa cakramantreṇa mantrayedatha vardhanīm || 99 ||
17.d: सास्त्रेण चक्रमन्त्रेण मन्त्रयेदथ वर्धनीम् ॥ 99 ॥
17.m: Then, O brahmin, he should make a charming sruva measuring a cubit; / the wood should be two digits in width and half of that in thickness. // 101

17.s: tatra cakrasthitaṃ cāstraṃ yajennārāyaṇātmakam |
17.d: तत्र चक्रस्थितं चास्त्रं यजेन्नारायणात्मकम् ।
17.m: At its tip, according to the measure of the width, he should make a circle of two digits; / gradually there is a sunken hollow, imprinted in a sphere, // 102

17.s:
[vardhanīsthasaliladhārayā bhittisaṃsecanapūrvakaṃ kalaśasya
bhrāmaṇavidhiḥ]
17.d:
[वर्धनीस्थसलिलधारया भित्तिसंसेचनपूर्वकं कलशस्य
भ्रामणविधिः]
17.m: adorned in the middle with a mark shaped like a deer's hoof; / the neck is one-third of the width, angular, and three digits [long]. // 103

17.s: tayā bhittigaṇaṃ sarvaṃ saṃsicyācchinnadhārayā || 100 ||
17.d: तया भित्तिगणं सर्वं संसिच्याच्छिन्नधारया ॥ 100 ॥
17.m: At the base, on both sides, he should make a svastika two digits in length; / the handle should be endowed with varied design or smooth. // 104

17.s:
pradakṣiṇakrameṇaivamīśakoṇādito dvija |
pṛṣṭhataḥ kalaśo bhrāmyasstulyakālaṃ tu vā pṛthak || 101 ||
17.d:
प्रदक्षिणक्रमेणैवमीशकोणादितो द्विज ।
पृष्ठतः कलशो भ्राम्यस्स्तुल्यकालं तु वा पृथक् ॥ 101 ॥
17.m: The practitioner should make a sruva of such a kind for the rite of oblation; / then, for the consecration of the fire, he should perform the oblation with it. // 105

17.s: [atha bhrāmitasya kalaśasya sthāpanavidhiḥ]
17.d: [अथ भ्रामितस्य कलशस्य स्थापनविधिः]
17.m: [The two kinds of consecration of the fire]

17.s:
śālyādiṣu paristhāpyaḥ kalaśo vardhanīyutaḥ |
īśadiksaṃmukhaṃ cātha puṣpādyaiḥ pūjayetpunaḥ || 102 ||
17.d:
शाल्यादिषु परिस्थाप्यः कलशो वर्धनीयुतः ।
ईशदिक्संमुखं चाथ पुष्पाद्यैः पूजयेत्पुनः ॥ 102 ॥
17.m: There are ten consecrations of the fire situated within the kuṇḍa, / and five consecrations externally; thus fifteen are traditionally taught. // 106

17.s: [sthāpitasya kalaśasya pūjanam]
17.d: [स्थापितस्य कलशस्य पूजनम्]
17.m: Sprinkling, striking, worship externally, veiling, / and making the fire immortal—these five were declared earlier. // 107

17.s:
astreṇa vastrayugmaṃ tu ahataṃ cābhimantrya vai |
dhūpādivāsitaṃ kṛtvā tāvubhau pariveṣṭya ca || 103 ||
17.d:
अस्त्रेण वस्त्रयुग्मं तु अहतं चाभिमन्त्र्य वै ।
धूपादिवासितं कृत्वा तावुभौ परिवेष्ट्य च ॥ 103 ॥
17.m: [Consecrations of the fire: placing the embryo and others]

17.s: pūjāṃ kṛtvā'tha puṣpādyaiḥ
17.d: पूजां कृत्वाऽथ पुष्पाद्यैः
17.m: Within the kuṇḍa, O brahmin, in the east on Lakṣmī, the rites are to be employed: / placing the embryo, the rite for procuring a male child, then the fashioning of the mouth, // 108

17.s: [sthaṇḍile'gnau ca hareryajanavidhānam]
17.d: [स्थण्डिलेऽग्नौ च हरेर्यजनविधानम्]
17.m: parting the hair, the emergence of the mouth, the first exit, the birth rite, / naming, enjoyment, the first feeding and so forth, completely, O twice-born, // 109

17.s: sthaṇḍile'tha yajeddharim |
17.d: स्थण्डिलेऽथ यजेद्धरिम् ।
17.m: and investiture—he should perform all [these] with the heart[-mantra], O Nārada.

17.s: pūrvoktena vidhānena tatognermadhyato yajet || 104 ||
17.d: पूर्वोक्तेन विधानेन ततोग्नेर्मध्यतो यजेत् ॥ 104 ॥
17.m: [Now the consecrations of the ghee]

17.s: p. 163) santarpya pūrvavidhinā caruṃ vai sādhayettataḥ |
17.d: प्। 163) सन्तर्प्य पूर्वविधिना चरुं वै साधयेत्ततः ।
17.m: In the rite of the ghee, he should thus perform ten according to the rules: // 110

17.s: [atha carusādhanaprakāraḥ]
17.d: [अथ चरुसाधनप्रकारः]
17.m: first, placing over the fire with the heart-mantra and the armour[-mantra], / floating and skimming, and likewise placing adjacent, // 111

17.s: prakṣālya ca purā'streṇa gandhairālipya cāntarāt || 105 ||
17.d: प्रक्षाल्य च पुराऽस्त्रेण गन्धैरालिप्य चान्तरात् ॥ 105 ॥
17.m: clarifying and purifying, / then waving lights; these three, O Nārada, // 112

17.s:
kṣīreṇa havirāpūrya hṛnmantreṇa tu nārada |
lakṣayitvā śṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ nikṣipettaṇḍulāṃstataḥ || 106 ||
17.d:
क्षीरेण हविरापूर्य हृन्मन्त्रेण तु नारद ।
लक्षयित्वा शृतं क्षीरं निक्षिपेत्तण्डुलांस्ततः ॥ 106 ॥
17.m: are to be performed with the heart-mantra; veiling is with the armour[-mantra]; / immediately after that, gazing and making immortal with the same. // 113

17.s:
śaktimantracatuṣkeṇa cālayetsihmamūrtinā |
siddhamuttārayetkuṇḍānmantreṇa kapilātmanā || 107 ||
17.d:
शक्तिमन्त्रचतुष्केण चालयेत्सिह्ममूर्तिना ।
सिद्धमुत्तारयेत्कुण्डान्मन्त्रेण कपिलात्मना ॥ 107 ॥
17.m: Know the touching of the ghee situated in the vessel / with kindled darbha grass first to be the consecration named 'placing over the fire.' // 114

17.s:
prakṣālyālipya ca tato mantreṇa kroḍamūrtinā |
sthagayenmūlamantreṇa
17.d:
प्रक्षाल्यालिप्य च ततो मन्त्रेण क्रोडमूर्तिना ।
स्थगयेन्मूलमन्त्रेण
17.m: Then, having taken with both hands a blade of kusa pressed by the ring finger and thumb / and bent in the middle, over the ghee // 115

17.s: [siddhasya caroścaturdhā vibhajya viniyogavidhānam]
17.d: [सिद्धस्य चरोश्चतुर्धा विभज्य विनियोगविधानम्]
17.m: he should move it back and forth, O brahmin, and cast that kusa into the fire; / these two consecrations are proclaimed as 'floating' and 'skimming.' // 116

17.s: caturdhā saṃvibhajya tat || 108 ||
17.d: चतुर्धा संविभज्य तत् ॥ 108 ॥
17.m: That which is called its melting is termed 'placing adjacent'; / pouring it into another vessel for the removal of defects // 117

17.s:
sthaṇḍilārādhitasyādau bhāgamekaṃ nivedya ca |
madhvājyasaṃplutaṃ kṛtvā dvitīyaṃ kalaśasthite || 109 ||
17.d:
स्थण्डिलाराधितस्यादौ भागमेकं निवेद्य च ।
मध्वाज्यसंप्लुतं कृत्वा द्वितीयं कलशस्थिते ॥ 109 ॥
17.m: is indeed 'clarifying'; then he should cast a purifier of darbha / into its middle, and that is 'purifying.' // 118

17.s:
tṛtīyaṃ bhāgamādāya tamagnisthe tu homayet |
parivāre baliṃ dadyātsthaleśakalaśāvadhau (?) || 110 ||
17.d:
तृतीयं भागमादाय तमग्निस्थे तु होमयेत् ।
परिवारे बलिं दद्यात्स्थलेशकलशावधौ (?) ॥ 110 ॥
17.m: Taking a blazing brand free from smoke from the kuṇḍa, / circling once with it, O brahmin—that is remembered as 'waving lights.' // 119

17.s: [sthaṇḍilādisthānatraye devasya punaḥ pūjanam]
17.d: [स्थण्डिलादिस्थानत्रये देवस्य पुनः पूजनम्]
17.m: Having made it free of dust, he should then visualize it within the interior of the armour; / this is 'veiling,' which is done circumambulating with the index finger. // 120

17.s:
mudrāṃ badhvā tato japtvā puṣpādyaiḥ pūjayetpunaḥ |
tristhānasthaṃ kramāddevaṃ śiṣyānāhūya maṇḍitān || 111 ||
17.d:
मुद्रां बध्वा ततो जप्त्वा पुष्पाद्यैः पूजयेत्पुनः ।
त्रिस्थानस्थं क्रमाद्देवं शिष्यानाहूय मण्डितान् ॥ 111 ॥
17.m: Gazing is by the radiance situated in the heart, reached to the eye; / this is the 'inspecting,' O brahmin; then, above it, he should meditate on // 121

17.s: [śiṣyāṇāṃ prokṣaṇam]
17.d: [शिष्याणां प्रोक्षणम्]

17.s:
susnātāndhautavastrāṃśca pavitrīkṛtavigrahān |
dvāradeśasthitānkṛtvā bahirvāsāntare dvija || 112 ||
17.d:
सुस्नातान्धौतवस्त्रांश्च पवित्रीकृतविग्रहान् ।
द्वारदेशस्थितान्कृत्वा बहिर्वासान्तरे द्विज ॥ 112 ॥
17.m: Within it he should visualize the Lord of Mantras, resembling the Snow Mountain, / and through the streams of nectar flowing from it, born of the moon and also born of the cow, // 123

17.s: prokṣayedarghyapātrāttu prāgastreṇa tu nārada |
17.d: प्रोक्षयेदर्घ्यपात्रात्तु प्रागस्त्रेण तु नारद ।
17.m: he should meditate on the clarified butter, consecrated with all rites and infused [with power]. / This, called 'immortalization', has been revealed to you. // 124

17.s: [atha sarvāṅgasaṃsparśaḥ]
17.d: [अथ सर्वाङ्गसंस्पर्शः]
17.m: Having inspected and immortalized [it], the two eyes are to be offered.

17.s: sarvāṅgālabhanaṃ kuryācchākhājaptaiḥ padaiḥ kramāt || 113 ||
17.d: सर्वाङ्गालभनं कुर्याच्छाखाजप्तैः पदैः क्रमात् ॥ 113 ॥
17.m: [Oblation of clarified butter successively into the right and left sides of the kuṇḍa with sruc and sruva]

17.s: [abhimantritasyārghyapuṣpasya śirasi prakṣepaḥ]
17.d: [अभिमन्त्रितस्यार्घ्यपुष्पस्य शिरसि प्रक्षेपः]
17.m: Having filled the sruva with clarified butter, he should meditate with the seed-syllable of the sun, // 125

17.s: datvā'rghyapuṣpaṃ śirasi śiromantrābhimantritam |
17.d: दत्वाऽर्घ्यपुष्पं शिरसि शिरोमन्त्राभिमन्त्रितम् ।
17.m: and offer to the Thousand-Rayed One in its middle on the right side of the kuṇḍa. / Then in the other ladle, having meditated with the syllable named Soma, // 126

17.s: [śiṣyāṇāṃ mantramayaśarīratvāpādanam]
17.d: [शिष्याणां मन्त्रमयशरीरत्वापादनम्]
17.m: he should offer the full [oblation] with the moon seed-syllable on the north of it.

17.s: dahanotpādanaṃ kuryātpūrvavatkramayogataḥ || 114 ||
17.d: दहनोत्पादनं कुर्यात्पूर्ववत्क्रमयोगतः ॥ 114 ॥
17.m: [Manner of worshipping the nature of Agni-Soma in the middle part of the kuṇḍa]

17.s: p. 164) tatasteṣāṃ vidhānena kuryānmantramayīṃ tanum |
17.d: प्। 164) ततस्तेषां विधानेन कुर्यान्मन्त्रमयीं तनुम् ।
17.m: After those two, he should worship in the interior that which consists of Agni and Soma: // 127

17.s: [guruṇā śiṣye kartavyo bhāvanāviśeṣaḥ]
17.d: [गुरुणा शिष्ये कर्तव्यो भावनाविशेषः]
17.m: the seed-syllable which belongs to the real principle and to the entire body, / wherein the bodily constituents are situated without distinction; // 128

17.s: yathā'tmani purā deve yathā'gnau kalaśe yathā || 115 ||
17.d: यथाऽत्मनि पुरा देवे यथाऽग्नौ कलशे यथा ॥ 115 ॥
17.m: having meditated on it resembling a peacock's throat, situated within the Lakṣmī seed-syllable, / with the aforesaid pair of seed-syllables unified into a single mantra, // 129

17.s:
śiṣyasya ca tathā dhyāyetsakalānniṣkalātparam |
paraṃ ca tryakṣareṇaiva kevalena tu nārada || 116 ||
17.d:
शिष्यस्य च तथा ध्यायेत्सकलान्निष्कलात्परम् ।
परं च त्र्यक्षरेणैव केवलेन तु नारद ॥ 116 ॥
17.m: he should himself offer clarified butter as before, accompanied by meditation and the weapon.

17.s:
saṃskārassakalaḥ proktaḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ |
niṣkalaḥ śaktirūpastu madhyamo mantranāyakaḥ || 117 ||
17.d:
संस्कारस्सकलः प्रोक्तः शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः ।
निष्कलः शक्तिरूपस्तु मध्यमो मन्त्रनायकः ॥ 117 ॥
17.m: [Consecration of oblational substances such as sesame with clarified butter]

17.s:
paraḥśaktyavasānastu praṇamātmā (vātmā ?) vyavasthitaḥ |
sakalādhiṣṭhitā vyaktā prakṛtiḥ spaṣṭarūpiṇī || 118 ||
17.d:
परःशक्त्यवसानस्तु प्रणमात्मा (वात्मा ?) व्यवस्थितः ।
सकलाधिष्ठिता व्यक्ता प्रकृतिः स्पष्टरूपिणी ॥ 118 ॥
17.m: Then, all oblational substances such as sesame are to be consecrated with clarified butter. // 130

17.s:
niṣkalādhiṣṭhitaṃ jñeyamavyaktaṃ puruṣīścitim | (?)
mantrarūpeṇa devena sadasadvyaktirūpiṇā || 119 ||
17.d:
निष्कलाधिष्ठितं ज्ञेयमव्यक्तं पुरुषीश्चितिम् । (?)
मन्त्ररूपेण देवेन सदसद्व्यक्तिरूपिणा ॥ 119 ॥
17.m: [Explanation of the rites of conception and so forth for the fire]

17.s: pareṇādhiṣṭhitaṃ sarvaṃ vyaktāvyaktaṃ cidātmakam |
17.d: परेणाधिष्ठितं सर्वं व्यक्ताव्यक्तं चिदात्मकम् ।
17.m: Now an oblation is to be made into the fire for the accomplishment of all life-cycle rites. / Having enclosed the fire with the heart-mantra, he should utter the name of the rite, // 131

17.s:
[svasya śiṣyasya coktaprakāreṇaikībhāvaṃ bhāvayato guroreva
saṃsāravimocakatvoktiḥ]
17.d:
[स्वस्य शिष्यस्य चोक्तप्रकारेणैकीभावं भावयतो गुरोरेव
संसारविमोचकत्वोक्तिः]
17.m: ending with 'saṃpādayāmi svāhā'; this is the sequence in all rites.

17.s: evaṃ devaṃ svamātmānaṃ śiṣyaṃ ca puruṣātmakam || 120 ||
17.d: एवं देवं स्वमात्मानं शिष्यं च पुरुषात्मकम् ॥ 120 ॥
17.m: [Now, explanation of the conception rite therein]

17.s:
ekībhāvena yo vetti nyāsakāle parasya tu |
dīkṣādhivāsane vipra sa saṃsārādvimocakaḥ || 121 ||
17.d:
एकीभावेन यो वेत्ति न्यासकाले परस्य तु ।
दीक्षाधिवासने विप्र स संसाराद्विमोचकः ॥ 121 ॥
17.m: The entry of that which is outside into the cavity of Śrī's womb— // 132

17.s: [matramūrterbhagavataḥ sannidhau vijñāpanam]
17.d: [मत्रमूर्तेर्भगवतः सन्निधौ विज्ञापनम्]
17.m: know that, O sage, to be the first life-cycle rite, the conception rite.

17.s:
vijñāpyaścātha bhagavānsthalastho mantravigrahaḥ |
sabandhānvaiṣayaiḥ pāśaiḥ videhaṃ (vivaśān ?) paśupakṣivat || 122 ||
17.d:
विज्ञाप्यश्चाथ भगवान्स्थलस्थो मन्त्रविग्रहः ।
सबन्धान्वैषयैः पाशैः विदेहं (विवशान् ?) पशुपक्षिवत् ॥ 122 ॥
17.m: [Puṃsavana]

17.s:
tvadanugrahasāmarthyānmokṣayāmi jagadguro |
vijñāpyo bhgavanevaṃ vinivedya paśū(?)nvibhoḥ || 123 ||
17.d:
त्वदनुग्रहसामर्थ्यान्मोक्षयामि जगद्गुरो ।
विज्ञाप्यो भ्गवनेवं विनिवेद्य पशू(?)न्विभोः ॥ 123 ॥
17.m: And the power of fire situated in Śrī's belly through the connection of scent, // 133

17.s: putrāḥ śiṣyāstathā bhṛtyāstathai(vai ?)va parameśvara |
17.d: पुत्राः शिष्यास्तथा भृत्यास्तथै(वै ?)व परमेश्वर ।
17.m: flame-formed, imperishable, subtle, whose expansion of consciousness [develops] / gradually from contact with the consciousness of the Lord's power— // 134

17.s: [ahatena vāsasā śiṣyasya netrabandhanam]
17.d: [अहतेन वाससा शिष्यस्य नेत्रबन्धनम्]
17.m: having meditated on it, he should offer clarified butter with its spoken mantra. / And the puṃsavana of the fire occurs through bringing forth the conscious power. // 135

17.s: vāsasā hyahatenātha śuddhena susitena ca || 124 ||
17.d: वाससा ह्यहतेनाथ शुद्धेन सुसितेन च ॥ 124 ॥
17.m: [Now, formation of the mouths]

17.s: netramantrābhijaptena netre śiṣyasya bandhayet |
17.d: नेत्रमन्त्राभिजप्तेन नेत्रे शिष्यस्य बन्धयेत् ।
17.m: From the mouth of that awakened, flaming one, they arise, / capable of illumination and burning; of him who is now formless, // 136

17.s: [pinaddhanetrasya śiṣyasya hastena puṣpāñjaliprakṣepaṇam]
17.d: [पिनद्धनेत्रस्य शिष्यस्य हस्तेन पुष्पाञ्जलिप्रक्षेपणम्]
17.m: having only a spherical shape, know that to be the formation of the mouths.

17.s: amantraṃ kṣepayeccāto viṣṇoḥ puṣpāñjaliṃ sthale || 125 ||
17.d: अमन्त्रं क्षेपयेच्चातो विष्णोः पुष्पाञ्जलिं स्थले ॥ 125 ॥
17.m: [Names of the seven flames of the mouth]

17.s: [puṣpāñjalipatanānusāreṇa śiṣyasya nāmakaraṇam]
17.d: [पुष्पाञ्जलिपतनानुसारेण शिष्यस्य नामकरणम्]
17.m: And hear the names of those mouth-flames, O Nārada: // 137

17.s:
yatra sā patati brahmanbuddhisaṅkalpite'mbuje |
p. 165) navadhā vibhajetprāgvattannāmānaṃ tamaṅkayet || 126 ||
17.d:
यत्र सा पतति ब्रह्मन्बुद्धिसङ्कल्पितेऽम्बुजे ।
प्। 165) नवधा विभजेत्प्राग्वत्तन्नामानं तमङ्कयेत् ॥ 126 ॥
17.m: Prabhā, Dīpti, and Prakāśā, Marīci, and Tapanī, / Karālā, and Lelihā, stationed pervading the kuṇḍa. // 138

17.s: viṣṇuśabdānvitenaiva patiṃ(ti ?)saṃjñāyutena ca |
17.d: विष्णुशब्दान्वितेनैव पतिं(ति ?)संज्ञायुतेन च ।
17.m: The triad beginning with Prabhā is taught in the northeast, east, and southeast; / and the triad beginning with Marīci is in the southwest, west, and northwest; // 139

17.s: [amantrakaṃ kalaśapūjanam]
17.d: [अमन्त्रकं कलशपूजनम्]
17.m: one named Lelihā stands from the middle of the north to the south.

17.s: amantramarcayetpaścātkalaśaṃ sāstravardhanīm || 127 ||
17.d: अमन्त्रमर्चयेत्पश्चात्कलशं सास्त्रवर्धनीम् ॥ 127 ॥
17.m: [Group of seed-syllables for the flames of the mouth]

17.s: [māyāsūtravidhānanirūpaṇam]
17.d: [मायासूत्रविधाननिरूपणम्]
17.m: The whole group of seed-syllables for these ends with the fire seed-syllable, // 140

17.s: susitaṃ sūtramādāya lākṣālaktakabhāvitam |
17.d: सुसितं सूत्रमादाय लाक्षालक्तकभावितम् ।
17.m: beginning with the praṇava and ending with 'namaḥ', precisely in the manner previously stated.

17.s: [tatra sūtramānam]
17.d: [तत्र सूत्रमानम्]

17.s: sammukhaṃ cotthitaṃ śiṣyaṃ samapādaśironnatam || 128 ||
17.d: सम्मुखं चोत्थितं शिष्यं समपादशिरोन्नतम् ॥ 128 ॥
17.m: And all the unmanifest limbs within it, such as head and hands, // 141

17.s:
kṛtvā'ṅguṣṭhadvayasyāgrātsamārabhya dvijottama |
yāvacchikhāvasānaṃ tu sūtramānaṃ samāharet || 129 ||
17.d:
कृत्वाऽङ्गुष्ठद्वयस्याग्रात्समारभ्य द्विजोत्तम ।
यावच्छिखावसानं तु सूत्रमानं समाहरेत् ॥ 129 ॥
17.m: which, having awakened, resort each to its own boundary of action— / the conception of their division is called the partioning of the hair. // 142

17.s: [tasya sūtrasyaikaguṇadviguṇatvādyanyatamavidhānam]
17.d: [तस्य सूत्रस्यैकगुणद्विगुणत्वाद्यन्यतमविधानम्]
17.m: [Now, emergence of the faces]

17.s:
kuryādekaguṇaṃ tadvai dviguṇaṃ triguṇaṃ tu vā |
tritristhaguṇitaṃ vātha pañcaviṃśatidhā tu vā || 130 ||
17.d:
कुर्यादेकगुणं तद्वै द्विगुणं त्रिगुणं तु वा ।
त्रित्रिस्थगुणितं वाथ पञ्चविंशतिधा तु वा ॥ 130 ॥
17.m: The faces beginning with Narasiṃha, resembling glittering stars, / situated in the midst of the conscious power; and that power, transformed completely // 143

17.s: [tasya sūtrasya sarvavikāraprakṛtibhūtāvyaktatvenabhāvanam]
17.d: [तस्य सूत्रस्य सर्वविकारप्रकृतिभूताव्यक्तत्वेनभावनम्]
17.m: into that nature, O brahmin—from it they indeed go forth, / each to its own place by its own power; this is called the emergence of the faces. // 144

17.s:
avyaktaliṅgasūtraṃ tu prāgavidyākalātmakam |
nityaṃ jaḍaṃ vyāpakaṃ ca tasminviśvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam || 131 ||
17.d:
अव्यक्तलिङ्गसूत्रं तु प्रागविद्याकलात्मकम् ।
नित्यं जडं व्यापकं च तस्मिन्विश्वं प्रतिष्ठितम् ॥ 131 ॥
17.m: [Now, emergence]

17.s:
tatrāpta(sta ?)mayate bhūyastasmādvai saṃpravartate |
tatrasthāṃ cintayetsarvāmabhinnāṃ tattvavardhanīm || 132 ||
17.d:
तत्राप्त(स्त ?)मयते भूयस्तस्माद्वै संप्रवर्तते ।
तत्रस्थां चिन्तयेत्सर्वामभिन्नां तत्त्ववर्धनीम् ॥ 132 ॥
17.m: The visualized emergence with the breath of the mouth from the realm of Śrī's belly / is the fire's life-cycle rite of emergence; and he should offer for it. // 145

17.s:
tatrodbhavāstu ye vipra pāśabandhātmakā dṛḍhāḥ |
rāgeṇa rañjitāścitrā avidyāsaṃpradīpitāḥ || 133 ||
17.d:
तत्रोद्भवास्तु ये विप्र पाशबन्धात्मका दृढाः ।
रागेण रञ्जिताश्चित्रा अविद्यासंप्रदीपिताः ॥ 133 ॥
17.m: [Now, birth-rite]

17.s: vicchinnāścaiva kālena niyatā vyāpakāstathā |
17.d: विच्छिन्नाश्चैव कालेन नियता व्यापकास्तथा ।
17.m: And when it has come out of the womb, that is declared to be the birth-rite.

17.s:
[tasya sūtrasyaikadvitryādyanyatamaprakāreṇa tattvasaṅkhyākrameṇa
yathecchaṃ graṃthanam]
17.d:
[तस्य सूत्रस्यैकद्वित्र्याद्यन्यतमप्रकारेण तत्त्वसङ्ख्याक्रमेण
यथेच्छं ग्रंथनम्]
17.m:
[Feeding]

A bath and feeding with gold, honey, and clarified butter, O twice-born. // 146

17.s: tattvasaṅkhyākrameṇaiva grathayettadvijecchayā || 134 ||
17.d: तत्त्वसङ्ख्याक्रमेणैव ग्रथयेत्तद्विजेच्छया ॥ 134 ॥

17.s:
ekadhā vā dvidhā caiva tridhā vā navadhā mune |
saṃkṣiptaṃ vistareṇātha grathayetpañcapañcadhā || 135 ||
17.d:
एकधा वा द्विधा चैव त्रिधा वा नवधा मुने ।
संक्षिप्तं विस्तरेणाथ ग्रथयेत्पञ्चपञ्चधा ॥ 135 ॥
17.m: [Naming]

17.s:
[bhogamokṣārthinaḥ śiṣyasya tadantarāyonmūlanārthaṃ
śiṣyaśarīratayā bhāvite sūtre tattvasṛṣṭikrameṇa
śikhāprabhṛticaraṇāntāvayavabhāvanāpūrvakaṃ homasya
kartavyatāvidhānam]
17.d:
[भोगमोक्षार्थिनः शिष्यस्य तदन्तरायोन्मूलनार्थं
शिष्यशरीरतया भाविते सूत्रे तत्त्वसृष्टिक्रमेण
शिखाप्रभृतिचरणान्तावयवभावनापूर्वकं होमस्य
कर्तव्यताविधानम्]
17.m: Thereafter, he should diligently bestow a name on the fire that has been born, / ending with the suffix -nāma, with the praṇava, for the Vaiṣṇava fire. // 147

17.s:
tattvasṛṣṭikrameṇaiva śikhāgrāccaraṇāvadhi |
p. 166) bhaviṣyatphaladehe'sau (sya ?) kṛtakṛtyasya karmaṇaḥ || 136 ||
17.d:
तत्त्वसृष्टिक्रमेणैव शिखाग्राच्चरणावधि ।
प्। 166) भविष्यत्फलदेहेऽसौ (स्य ?) कृतकृत्यस्य कर्मणः ॥ 136 ॥
17.m: [Enjoyment]

17.s:
kalpayitvā tu hotavyo mantrairnimūlakāraṇam |
bhogamokṣaprasaktasya bādhante na yathā punaḥ || 137 ||
17.d:
कल्पयित्वा तु होतव्यो मन्त्रैर्निमूलकारणम् ।
भोगमोक्षप्रसक्तस्य बाधन्ते न यथा पुनः ॥ 137 ॥
17.m: Enjoyment begins with the first feeding of solid food and ends with marriage; / unction is one rite; oblation is to be made as before, O twice-born. // 148

17.s:
kadāciddehapādādyaiḥ karmāṇi munisattama |
anicchamānasya balājjantoḥ saṃpreyaranti ca || 138 ||
17.d:
कदाचिद्देहपादाद्यैः कर्माणि मुनिसत्तम ।
अनिच्छमानस्य बलाज्जन्तोः संप्रेयरन्ति च ॥ 138 ॥
17.m: [Now, investiture with authority]

17.s:
seśvare prākṛte dehe sa hi karmāspado yataḥ |
āśrayasya tvabhāvena karmāṇyupaśamanti ca || 139 ||
17.d:
सेश्वरे प्राकृते देहे स हि कर्मास्पदो यतः ।
आश्रयस्य त्वभावेन कर्माण्युपशमन्ति च ॥ 139 ॥
17.m: Then the rite named 'investiture with authority', which assumes manifold forms.

17.s:
svayameva yathā vahnerjvālādyā indhanaṃ vinā |
bhogāsaktasya vai jantorante mokṣābhikāṃkṣiṇaḥ || 140 ||
17.d:
स्वयमेव यथा वह्नेर्ज्वालाद्या इन्धनं विना ।
भोगासक्तस्य वै जन्तोरन्ते मोक्षाभिकांक्षिणः ॥ 140 ॥
17.m: [Meditation on the fire consecrated by the aforesaid rites as Nārāyaṇa]

17.s: saṃvidhānamidaṃ kuryānna nirvāṇāśritasya ca |
17.d: संविधानमिदं कुर्यान्न निर्वाणाश्रितस्य च ।
17.m: Having thus visualized the fire, purified by the life-cycle rites, having the nature of Nārāyaṇa, // 149

17.s:
[sūtraṃ kuṃḍasamīpaṃ nītvā tasmin sūtrātmake dehe tattvānāṃ
saṃkṣepavistārābhyāṃ pūrvoktaika
dvitryādigranthanaprakāravikalpānuguṇaṃ smaraṇaprakāraḥ]
17.d:
[सूत्रं कुंडसमीपं नीत्वा तस्मिन् सूत्रात्मके देहे तत्त्वानां
संक्षेपविस्ताराभ्यां पूर्वोक्तैक
द्वित्र्यादिग्रन्थनप्रकारविकल्पानुगुणं स्मरणप्रकारः]
17.m: four-armed, four-faced, holding conch, discus, mace, and lotus, / situated in the center of the kuṇḍa, radiant like the rising sun, // 150

17.s: sādhuparṇapuṭe sūtraṃ kṛtvā taṃ mallake'tha vā || 141 ||
17.d: साधुपर्णपुटे सूत्रं कृत्वा तं मल्लकेऽथ वा ॥ 141 ॥
17.m: [Visualization of entry into the heart along the path of flames]

17.s:
prayāyātkuṇḍanikaṭaṃ saha śiṣyeṇa vai guruḥ |
nidhāya kuṇḍanikaṭe dehe śaiṣye'tha sautrake || 142 ||
17.d:
प्रयायात्कुण्डनिकटं सह शिष्येण वै गुरुः ।
निधाय कुण्डनिकटे देहे शैष्येऽथ सौत्रके ॥ 142 ॥
17.m: then [the power] produced from it, which has arrived from the kuṇḍa by the path of flames, / shining with the light of supreme bliss, extending up to twelve [finger-breadths] from the nose, // 151

17.s:
tattvasaṅghaṃ smaredbhinnaṃ spaṣṭaṃ sṛṣṭikrameṇa tu |
kevalaṃ ceśvaraṃ vātha taṃ pradhānānvitaṃ tu vai || 143 ||
17.d:
तत्त्वसङ्घं स्मरेद्भिन्नं स्पष्टं सृष्टिक्रमेण तु ।
केवलं चेश्वरं वाथ तं प्रधानान्वितं तु वै ॥ 143 ॥
17.m: he should then meditate upon as having entered his heart by the process of descent.

17.s:
te dve tanmātrakaṃ vargamekaṃ ca bahudhātmakam |
īśvaraṃ prakṛtiṃ medhāmahaṅkārādikaṃ gaṇam || 144 ||
17.d:
ते द्वे तन्मात्रकं वर्गमेकं च बहुधात्मकम् ।
ईश्वरं प्रकृतिं मेधामहङ्कारादिकं गणम् ॥ 144 ॥
17.m: [Now, worship of the consecrated fire]

17.s:
navadhā vā muniśreṣṭha vistāreṇātha cintayet |
īśvarācca prathivyantaṃ yathā cānukrameṇa vā || 145 ||
17.d:
नवधा वा मुनिश्रेष्ठ विस्तारेणाथ चिन्तयेत् ।
ईश्वराच्च प्रथिव्यन्तं यथा चानुक्रमेण वा ॥ 145 ॥
17.m: Then, having performed the worship of the consecrated fire with devotion, // 152

17.s:
lalāṭādaṅghriparyantaṃ sthānabhedena nārada |
vyāpakatvena vai tattvaṃ sarveṣāṃ ca layaṃ gatam || 146 ||
17.d:
ललाटादङ्घ्रिपर्यन्तं स्थानभेदेन नारद ।
व्यापकत्वेन वै तत्त्वं सर्वेषां च लयं गतम् ॥ 146 ॥
17.m: with flowers, incense, curd, and sesame seeds mixed with unbroken grain, / with cooked food accompanied by delicacies and fruits, and with ghee in due order, O twice-born one, // 153

17.s: [tattvagaṇasya dīpālokayorivāpṛthagbhāvalakṣaṇamaikyam]
17.d: [तत्त्वगणस्य दीपालोकयोरिवापृथग्भावलक्षणमैक्यम्]
17.m: with a fulfilled heart and using his own mantra, he should then satisfy the fire / according to his capacity, with sesame, ghee, and other substances in succession. // 154

17.s:
pradīpācca yathā gehe bahavassthānabhedakāḥ |
dṛśyate(nte ?)ca tadudbhūta ālokona vibhāvyate || 147 ||
17.d:
प्रदीपाच्च यथा गेहे बहवस्स्थानभेदकाः ।
दृश्यते(न्ते ?)च तदुद्भूत आलोकोन विभाव्यते ॥ 147 ॥
17.m: Having offered the full offering to the fire ending in 'vauṣaṭ' with ghee,

17.s:
vyāpakatvātpṛthagrapamevaṃ tattvagaṇaṃ mune |
apṛthakca pṛthagbhūtaṃ saṃmiśraṃ tu vibhāvayet || 148 ||
17.d:
व्यापकत्वात्पृथग्रपमेवं तत्त्वगणं मुने ।
अपृथक्च पृथग्भूतं संमिश्रं तु विभावयेत् ॥ 148 ॥
17.m: [Worship of the deity in the middle of the fire]

17.s:
yathāvajjñānadṛṣṭyā tu buddhyā saṃśodhya yojayet |
evamevāpṛthagviddhi bhedamekasya taṃ prati || 149 ||
17.d:
यथावज्ज्ञानदृष्ट्या तु बुद्ध्या संशोध्य योजयेत् ।
एवमेवापृथग्विद्धि भेदमेकस्य तं प्रति ॥ 149 ॥
17.m: worship of the deity should then be performed in the middle of the fire. // 155

17.s: p. 167) diksaṃsthitasya yaccaikyaṃ miśrībhūtatvameva hi |
17.d: प्। 167) दिक्संस्थितस्य यच्चैक्यं मिश्रीभूतत्वमेव हि ।
17.m: [There, first the manner of visualizing the fire]

17.s: [tatraikadhāgranthanapakṣe]
17.d: [तत्रैकधाग्रन्थनपक्षे]
17.m: First, he should meditate on that fire endowed with form yet possessing undivided light, / all-pervading by the power of his yoga, extending to all directions, // 156

17.s: ekoccāraprayogeṇa īśaṃ sarvatra bhāvayet || 150 ||
17.d: एकोच्चारप्रयोगेण ईशं सर्वत्र भावयेत् ॥ 150 ॥
17.m: with hands, speech, and feet on all sides, with eyes, heads, and faces on all sides, / shaped like a kadamba flower, resplendent with its own radiance, // 157

17.s: [dvidhā granthanapakṣe]
17.d: [द्विधा ग्रन्थनपक्षे]
17.m: filling the whole kuṇḍa completely in all aspects. / Thus indeed, spread out, pervasive, formless, and brilliantly blazing, // 158

17.s:
dviruccāraprayogeṇa īśvaraṃ tu vibhāvayet |
vyaktau pradhānatattvaṃ tu vyāpakaṃ deharūpadhṛt || 151 ||
17.d:
द्विरुच्चारप्रयोगेण ईश्वरं तु विभावयेत् ।
व्यक्तौ प्रधानतत्त्वं तु व्यापकं देहरूपधृत् ॥ 151 ॥
17.m: [Worship of the deity in the midst of the fire meditated upon as all-pervasive like space]

17.s: [tridhā granthanapakṣe]
17.d: [त्रिधा ग्रन्थनपक्षे]
17.m: meditating upon the fire as like space, he should worship the Lord in its center, / with perfume, flowers, and the like;

17.s:
triruccāreṇa cāmūrdhno hṛdayāntaṃ smaredvibhum |
hṛdayānnābhiparyantaṃ pradhānaṃ paribhāvayet || 152 ||
17.d:
त्रिरुच्चारेण चामूर्ध्नो हृदयान्तं स्मरेद्विभुम् ।
हृदयान्नाभिपर्यन्तं प्रधानं परिभावयेत् ॥ 152 ॥
17.m: [Worship of the weapon and other deities]

17.s: ānābheḥ pādaparyantaṃ smarettanmātrakaṃ gaṇam |
17.d: आनाभेः पादपर्यन्तं स्मरेत्तन्मात्रकं गणम् ।
17.m: then he should worship the weapon and the armour. // 159

17.s: [navadhā granthanapakṣe]
17.d: [नवधा ग्रन्थनपक्षे]
17.m: On the path of the right arm, near Aniruddha, / consisting of Agni and Soma, for the purpose of self-protection, // 160

17.s: navadhā muniśārdūla evameva kramaṃ śṛṇu || 153 ||
17.d: नवधा मुनिशार्दूल एवमेव क्रमं शृणु ॥ 153 ॥
17.m: he [worships] the deity, the discus stationed in the discus.

17.s:
ākarṇādīśvaraṃ mūrdhni pradhānaṃ vakṣaso'ntare |
nābhau buddhimahaṅkāraṃ kandamūlāśritaṃ smaret || 154 ||
17.d:
आकर्णादीश्वरं मूर्ध्नि प्रधानं वक्षसोऽन्तरे ।
नाभौ बुद्धिमहङ्कारं कन्दमूलाश्रितं स्मरेत् ॥ 154 ॥
17.m: [Now, the rule for fire oblation]

17.s:
ūrubhyāṃ śabdatanmātraṃ sparśākhyaṃ sandhideśajam |
jaṅghābhyāṃ rūpatanmātraṃ gulphayorasasaṃjñitam || 155 ||
17.d:
ऊरुभ्यां शब्दतन्मात्रं स्पर्शाख्यं सन्धिदेशजम् ।
जङ्घाभ्यां रूपतन्मात्रं गुल्फयोरससंज्ञितम् ॥ 155 ॥
17.m: Then he should begin the fire oblation

17.s:
pādābhyāṃ gandhasaṃjñaṃ tu sabījaṃ dhyānasaṃyutam |
smareddehe śiśossūtre navagranthisamāyute || 156 ||
17.d:
पादाभ्यां गन्धसंज्ञं तु सबीजं ध्यानसंयुतम् ।
स्मरेद्देहे शिशोस्सूत्रे नवग्रन्थिसमायुते ॥ 156 ॥
17.m: with sesame seeds mixed with ghee and with all sacrificial substances, // 161

17.s: dhyāyeddhyātā dharāntaṃ vā dīkṣākāle hyupasthite |
17.d: ध्यायेद्ध्याता धरान्तं वा दीक्षाकाले ह्युपस्थिते ।
17.m: inundated with fragrant ghee, according to rule.

17.s: [atha tattvānāṃ homaḥ]
17.d: [अथ तत्त्वानां होमः]

17.s: lalāṭe ceśvaraṃ sākṣāccidrūpaṃ sarvato mukham || 157 ||
17.d: ललाटे चेश्वरं साक्षाच्चिद्रूपं सर्वतो मुखम् ॥ 157 ॥
17.m: He should offer for Lakṣmī and the others a fourth of the [oblations of the] root-mantra. // 162

17.s:
samagraiśvaryasaṃpūrṇaṃ svabījena mahāmate |
tadvadeva hi śiṣyasya dhvātvā tadanu homayet || 158 ||
17.d:
समग्रैश्वर्यसंपूर्णं स्वबीजेन महामते ।
तद्वदेव हि शिष्यस्य ध्वात्वा तदनु होमयेत् ॥ 158 ॥
17.m: From the oblation for the Śaktis, he should then offer half for the ancillary limbs; / with half of that, O best of the twice-born, he should make oblations for the faces. // 163

17.s:
svabījena śataṃ sāṣṭaṃ tadarddhaṃ tryaṃśameva vā |
tatpādamatha pādārdhaṃ jñātvāvyaktabalaṃ tu vai || 159 ||
17.d:
स्वबीजेन शतं साष्टं तदर्द्धं त्र्यंशमेव वा ।
तत्पादमथ पादार्धं ज्ञात्वाव्यक्तबलं तु वै ॥ 159 ॥
17.m: He should offer half of the [oblations of the] faces for Kaustubha and the others; / half of that for Satya and the others; and half of those to the supreme Imperishable. // 164

17.s:
hutvā'tha haviṣā'pūrya sravaṃ tena hune (?)cchiśum |
mūrdhni pūrṇopamaṃ kuṇḍe svāhāntaṃ tu vinikṣipet || 160 ||
17.d:
हुत्वाऽथ हविषाऽपूर्य स्रवं तेन हुने (?)च्छिशुम् ।
मूर्ध्नि पूर्णोपमं कुण्डे स्वाहान्तं तु विनिक्षिपेत् ॥ 160 ॥
17.m: With each being half, augmented by half a portion, and more for those situated in front,

17.s:
sūtraga(gra ?)ndhāvathordhvasthe tattatvaṃ bhāvayettathā |
evamīśvarasaṃpātaṃ homaṃ kṛtvā samāsataḥ || 161 ||
17.d:
सूत्रग(ग्र ?)न्धावथोर्ध्वस्थे तत्तत्वं भावयेत्तथा ।
एवमीश्वरसंपातं होमं कृत्वा समासतः ॥ 161 ॥
17.m: [The duty to perform oblations corresponding to the recitation]

17.s:
p. 168) pradhānaṃ ca bhuvormadhye svamantreṇa tu bhāvayet |
sindūrapuñjasaṅkāśaṃ homayettadvadeva hi || 162 ||
17.d:
प्। 168) प्रधानं च भुवोर्मध्ये स्वमन्त्रेण तु भावयेत् ।
सिन्दूरपुञ्जसङ्काशं होमयेत्तद्वदेव हि ॥ 162 ॥
17.m: as at the time of recitation, so in the oblation it must be performed by one desiring success. // 165

17.s:
sitenduraśmivarṇābhāṃ tālumadhye dhiyaṃ smaret |
kusumbharasasaṅkāśaṃ khadyotamiva khecaram || 163 ||
17.d:
सितेन्दुरश्मिवर्णाभां तालुमध्ये धियं स्मरेत् ।
कुसुम्भरससङ्काशं खद्योतमिव खेचरम् ॥ 163 ॥
17.m: Knowing this, he should then perform it from ten million oblations down to a hundred; / for a mantra that is not satisfied never bestows results, // 166

17.s:
tālumūle tvahaṅkāraṃ tālukarṇāntare tataḥ |
rājopaladyuti muṣaṃṣaḥ (mākṛteḥ ?) kadambakusumopamam || 164 ||
17.d:
तालुमूले त्वहङ्कारं तालुकर्णान्तरे ततः ।
राजोपलद्युति मुषंषः (माकृतेः ?) कदम्बकुसुमोपमम् ॥ 164 ॥
17.m: with desires that necessarily bear fruit arising according to place and time.

17.s:
manasaścānusandhānaṃ kuryātsantarpya pūrvavat |
karṇāddhṛtpadmaparyantaṃ smaretpañcapade same || 165 ||
17.d:
मनसश्चानुसन्धानं कुर्यात्सन्तर्प्य पूर्ववत् ।
कर्णाद्धृत्पद्मपर्यन्तं स्मरेत्पञ्चपदे समे ॥ 165 ॥
17.m: [Specification of oblation substances]

17.s:
śrotrādīnatha vai pañca prasphurattārakojvalān |
svaiḥ svairbījaiśca pūrvoktairdhyātvā santarpya pūrvavat || 166 ||
17.d:
श्रोत्रादीनथ वै पञ्च प्रस्फुरत्तारकोज्वलान् ।
स्वैः स्वैर्बीजैश्च पूर्वोक्तैर्ध्यात्वा सन्तर्प्य पूर्ववत् ॥ 166 ॥
17.m: [He should offer] with sesame seeds, ghee, milk, curd, or milk-rice, // 167

17.s:
tatsthānā - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - |
spanda (padma) sthānācca nābhyantaṃ prāgvatpañcapadāntare |
vāgādīnvai sthitān pañca bījaiḥ svaiḥ pūrvavatsmaret || 167 ||
17.d:
तत्स्थाना - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - ।
स्पन्द (पद्म) स्थानाच्च नाभ्यन्तं प्राग्वत्पञ्चपदान्तरे ।
वागादीन्वै स्थितान् पञ्च बीजैः स्वैः पूर्ववत्स्मरेत् ॥ 167 ॥
17.m: with cooked rice, prepared delicacies, seeds, parched grain, and husked rice, / with roots, fruits, or tender, highly praised shoots, // 168

17.s:
anukrameṇa caikaikamuccārya juhuyānnyaset |
ānābhervastiśīrṣāntaṃ susame padapañcake || 168 ||
17.d:
अनुक्रमेण चैकैकमुच्चार्य जुहुयान्न्यसेत् ।
आनाभेर्वस्तिशीर्षान्तं सुसमे पदपञ्चके ॥ 168 ॥
17.m: with fragrant flowers such as the land-lotus, O twice-born, white and other varieties, / with guggulu mixed with ghee, or with turpentine resin mixed with ghee, // 169

17.s:
śabdatanmātrapūrvāṇi gandhamātrāvasānataḥ |
svaiḥsvairguṇaiśca yuktāni bhāsvajjyotiḥprabhāṇi tu || 169 ||
17.d:
शब्दतन्मात्रपूर्वाणि गन्धमात्रावसानतः ।
स्वैःस्वैर्गुणैश्च युक्तानि भास्वज्ज्योतिःप्रभाणि तु ॥ 169 ॥
17.m: or with juicy myrobalan fruits, auspicious blue lotuses, / very white or white-and-red lotuses, and very beautiful bilva fruits, // 170

17.s:
ūrumūle tathā madhye buddhideśe (?)tatastvadhaḥ |
daṇḍe marmāvasāne tu (?)sarvasmiṃścaraṇe kramāt || 170 ||
17.d:
ऊरुमूले तथा मध्ये बुद्धिदेशे (?)ततस्त्वधः ।
दण्डे मर्मावसाने तु (?)सर्वस्मिंश्चरणे क्रमात् ॥ 170 ॥
17.m: with blades of dūrvā grass having unbroken tips, spotless like the fine tusks of an elephant, / with firewood obtained from the sacred tree and from milky trees, // 171

17.s:
khavāyyvagnyudakakṣmāntaṃ cintayedbhūtapañcakam |
ni(nī ?)rūpāñjanavarṇaṃ tu saṃsmaredvyomagolakam || 171 ||
17.d:
खवाय्य्वग्न्युदकक्ष्मान्तं चिन्तयेद्भूतपञ्चकम् ।
नि(नी ?)रूपाञ्जनवर्णं तु संस्मरेद्व्योमगोलकम् ॥ 171 ॥
17.m: [or with] guḍūcī combined with milk, [or firewood of] udumbara drenched in honey, / with tips unsevered and unbroken, devoid of thorns, // 172

17.s:
vāyavyaṃ nīlapītañca taijasaṃ madhupiṅgalam |
muktāphalanibhaṃ cāpyaṃ ratnapītaṃ tu pārthivam || 172 ||
17.d:
वायव्यं नीलपीतञ्च तैजसं मधुपिङ्गलम् ।
मुक्ताफलनिभं चाप्यं रत्नपीतं तु पार्थिवम् ॥ 172 ॥
17.m: all anointed with the three sweets, or again endowed with ghee.

17.s:
sadhyānadraṣṭā coṅkāraṃ bījaṃ tadanu vai namaḥ |
tatraiva kāle homārthaṃ bījaṃ praṇavapūrvakam || 173 ||
17.d:
सध्यानद्रष्टा चोङ्कारं बीजं तदनु वै नमः ।
तत्रैव काले होमार्थं बीजं प्रणवपूर्वकम् ॥ 173 ॥
17.m: [Different results according to different oblation substances]

17.s: tattatsajñaṃ tataḥ svāhā saṃpāte tvīdṛśo vidhiḥ |
17.d: तत्तत्सज्ञं ततः स्वाहा संपाते त्वीदृशो विधिः ।
17.m: With sesame seeds mixed with ghee [comes] pacification and all supernatural powers; // 173

17.s: [saṃpātahomaḥ ?]
17.d: [संपातहोमः ?]

17.s: turyātītapadāvastho guruḥ kuryādanugraham || 174 ||
17.d: तुर्यातीतपदावस्थो गुरुः कुर्यादनुग्रहम् ॥ 174 ॥
17.m: When the king of mantras is satisfied with seeds, grains, and husked rice, / the Supreme Lord, being pleased, always bestows welfare. // 175

17.s:
ekoccāreṇa śiṣyasya kriyāmapyaparityajan |
p. 169) dviruccāreṇa turyasthaḥ suṣuptāvasthagastribhiḥ || 175 ||
17.d:
एकोच्चारेण शिष्यस्य क्रियामप्यपरित्यजन् ।
प्। 169) द्विरुच्चारेण तुर्यस्थः सुषुप्तावस्थगस्त्रिभिः ॥ 175 ॥
17.m: Oblation with shoots, fruits, and roots bestows satisfaction, / wards off untimely death, and brings diseases to cessation. // 176

17.s:
navabhissvapnabhūmiṣṭho jāgratsthāno'khilairjuhet |
ekadhā vā ddhidhā tredhā pañcadhā pañcapañcadhā || 176 ||
17.d:
नवभिस्स्वप्नभूमिष्ठो जाग्रत्स्थानोऽखिलैर्जुहेत् ।
एकधा वा द्धिधा त्रेधा पञ्चधा पञ्चपञ्चधा ॥ 176 ॥
17.m: Satisfied with land-lotuses and other flowers, white and other [colors], / O twice-born one, he quickly bestows peerless good fortune. // 177

17.s:
hutvā saṃpātahomārthaṃ sarvadvandvopaśāntaye |
kuryātpūrṇāhutiṃ caiva homānte bījasantatam || 177 ||
17.d:
हुत्वा संपातहोमार्थं सर्वद्वन्द्वोपशान्तये ।
कुर्यात्पूर्णाहुतिं चैव होमान्ते बीजसन्ततम् ॥ 177 ॥
17.m: With guggulu and the like, O twice-born, [comes] freedom from disease, as also with auspicious myrobalan fruits; / and with lotus seeds smeared with ghee, he quickly bestows wealth. // 178

17.s:
samūlamantraṃ saṃsmṛtya vauṣaḍantaṃ mahāmune |
yaḥ pumān jīvasaṃjñastu tasyaitā bhogabhūmayaḥ || 178 ||
17.d:
समूलमन्त्रं संस्मृत्य वौषडन्तं महामुने ।
यः पुमान् जीवसंज्ञस्तु तस्यैता भोगभूमयः ॥ 178 ॥
17.m: One desiring subjugation or one desiring enjoyment should offer with blue lotuses; / by oblation with dūrvā grass and guḍūcī, one attains an increase of life-span. // 179

17.s:
ūrdhvādhobhyāmaviśrāntastāvatkuryādgamāgamam |
yāvanna guruṇā samyaṅmantramūrttau niyojitaḥ || 179 ||
17.d:
ऊर्ध्वाधोभ्यामविश्रान्तस्तावत्कुर्याद्गमागमम् ।
यावन्न गुरुणा सम्यङ्मन्त्रमूर्त्तौ नियोजितः ॥ 179 ॥
17.m: And through oblation with auspicious firewoods, the Lord bestows the pacification of faults.

17.s:
tatsthito bhagavacchaktikiraṇaiścāmalīkṛtaḥ |
nirmalo malasopānapadavīṃ na vrajetpunaḥ || 180 ||
17.d:
तत्स्थितो भगवच्छक्तिकिरणैश्चामलीकृतः ।
निर्मलो मलसोपानपदवीं न व्रजेत्पुनः ॥ 180 ॥
17.m: [Different quantities of oblations]

17.s:
evaṃ saṃpātahomaṃ tu saṃpādya ca purā mune |
vidhāya tattvasūtraṃ tu pātreṇaivāpareṇa tu || 181 ||
17.d:
एवं संपातहोमं तु संपाद्य च पुरा मुने ।
विधाय तत्त्वसूत्रं तु पात्रेणैवापरेण तु ॥ 181 ॥
17.m: The oblation of sesame seeds is always recommended to be done with the deer-gesture. // 180

17.s: saṃveṣṭya sitasūtreṇa gatvā'tha vinivedya ca |
17.d: संवेष्ट्य सितसूत्रेण गत्वाऽथ विनिवेद्य च ।
17.m: The oblation of ghee is one karṣa, and especially so for milk; / the oblation of curd is a śukti-measure, and a handful of milk-rice; // 181

17.s: [rajoghaṭikākartaryādyupakaraṇadravyāṇāmāsādanādisaṃskāraḥ]
17.d: [रजोघटिकाकर्तर्याद्युपकरणद्रव्याणामासादनादिसंस्कारः]
17.m: the measure of half a morsel of cooked grains, and of delicacies according to their own size; / he should perform the oblation of all seeds by the fistful. // 182

17.s: kumbhāgre vāyukoṇe vā rajāṃsi ghaṭikāṃ tathā || 182 ||
17.d: कुम्भाग्रे वायुकोणे वा रजांसि घटिकां तथा ॥ 182 ॥
